42188602.title: Co-Expression and Co-Purification Enable Manufacturing of a Six-Monoclonal Antibody Botulinum Antitoxin Cocktail.
42188602.abstract: A highly potent antitoxin for botulinum neurotoxin (BoNT) serotypes A and B has been developed that comprises three monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) targeting BoNT/A and three targeting BoNT/B. These oligoclonal antibody combinations neutralize toxin by simultaneously binding non-overlapping epitopes, thereby promoting rapid toxin clearance. All six mAbs use the same human Fc and framework and have been individually manufactured using the same expression platform and purification process. To minimize the time and labor required to produce the divalent antitoxin, we tested a co-expression and co-purification strategy for the three mAbs per serotype. The mAbs were expressed in CHO-K1 cells, and the media were optimized for co-expression in 10 L bioreactors. Chromatographic co-purification consisted of Protein A capture, followed by strong anion exchange chromatography in flow-through mode and cation-exchange chromatography in bind-elute mode. Co-expression experiments demonstrated that expression of the three anti-BoNT/A antibodies remained within approximately ±30% of the optimal equimolar ratio, whereas the anti-BoNT/B antibodies showed greater variability. Downstream purification steps achieved recoveries greater than 95% per chromatographic step, resulting in overall process yields of approximately 63-75%. This strategy provided sufficient purity of all six mAbs while largely preserving their relative ratios. These results demonstrate the feasibility of producing oligoclonal antitoxin antibodies using co-expression and shared purification strategies. Such approaches may simplify the manufacturing of antibody cocktails while maintaining product quality and biological activity.

42188602.title_zh: 共表达和共纯化能够制造六种单克隆抗体肉毒杆菌抗毒素混合物。
42188602.abstract_zh:
现已开发出针对肉毒杆菌神经毒素 (BoNT) 血清型 A 和 B 的高效抗毒素，其中包含三种靶向 BoNT/A 的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和三种靶向 BoNT/B 的单克隆抗体 (mAb)。这些寡克隆抗体组合通过同时结合非重叠表位来中和毒素，从而促进毒素快速清除。所有六种单克隆抗体均使用相同的人源 Fc 和框架，并使用相同的表达平台和纯化工艺单独生产。为了最大限度地减少生产二价抗毒素所需的时间和劳动力，我们测试了每种血清型三种单克隆抗体的共表达和共纯化策略。 mAb 在 CHO-K1 细胞中表达，并优化培养基以在 10 L 生物反应器中共表达。色谱共纯化包括蛋白质 A 捕获，然后是流通模式的强阴离子交换色谱和结合洗脱模式的阳离子交换色谱。共表达实验表明，三种抗 BoNT/A 抗体的表达保持在最佳等摩尔比的约 ±30% 范围内，而抗 BoNT/B 抗体则表现出更大的变异性。
下游纯化步骤的每个色谱步骤的回收率超过 95%，总体工艺收率约为 63-75%。该策略提供了所有六种单克隆抗体的足够纯度，同时很大程度上保留了它们的相对比例。这些结果证明了使用共表达和共享纯化策略生产寡克隆抗毒素抗体的可行性。这些方法可以简化抗体混合物的制造，同时保持产品质量和生物活性。

42586433.title: Biophysical investigations into the impact of crystallization conditions on monoclonal antibody properties and purification.
42586433.abstract: Crystallization of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) is a challenging problem given their large size and inherent structural complexity. Thousands of conditions need to be screened to arrive at a promising crystallization hit. Historically, crystallization has been successfully applied for preparative-scale purification and manufacturing of small molecules but rarely to produce mAbs, large globular proteins and peptides other than insulins. There is tremendous interest in the biopharmaceutical industry in exploring and implementing alternative strategies for the purification of biologics. One such non-platform, unit operation is crystallization. However, translatability across scales, robustness and amenability for large-scale processing are key challenges that need to be overcome to realize the success of crystallization as a unit operation in biomanufacturing. In this work, we take a biophysical characterization- driven approach to 1) elucidate differences between two unique crystallization conditions, previously identified via high-throughput screening, for a IgG4 mAb, and 2) demonstrate that the fundamental understanding generated from this biophysical characterization can enable a rational selection of crystallization conditions for bioprocessing applications. Results show that the crystallization conditions, both of which crystallize the mAb in two unique crystal structures, can impact the mAb structure and solution-state biophysical properties quite differently leading to significantly different outcomes in thermal and colloidal stability of the protein as well as in the purification of the mAb via crystallization as a unit operation. Second, this work highlights that co-crystallization of a large macromolecule like a mAb with a small molecule like caffeine can dramatically influence solution stability as well as impurity rejection. Third, and related to above we demonstrate that not all crystallization conditions that lead to structure elucidation are amenable for bioprocessing, as certain solution conditions can negatively impact protein solution stability and conformation, impurity co-precipitation thereby leading to lower impurity clearance from complex bioprocess feeds. For bioprocessing applications it is therefore critical to understand the impact of a condition on not just the pure mAb but also on the mAb in complex solutions alongside impurities.

42586433.title_zh: 关于结晶条件对单克隆抗体特性和纯化影响的生物物理学研究。
42586433.abstract_zh:
鉴于单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的体积大和固有的结构复杂性，其结晶是一个具有挑战性的问题。需要筛选数千种条件才能获得有希望的结晶结果。历史上，结晶已成功应用于小分子的制备级纯化和制造，但很少用于生产单克隆抗体、大球状蛋白和胰岛素以外的肽。生物制药行业对探索和实施生物制品纯化的替代策略有着极大的兴趣。结晶就是这样一种非平台、单元操作。然而，跨尺度的可翻译性、大规模加工的稳健性和适应性是实现结晶作为生物制造中的单元操作的成功需要克服的关键挑战。
在这项工作中，我们采用生物物理表征驱动的方法来 1) 阐明先前通过高通量筛选鉴定的 IgG4 mAb 的两种独特结晶条件之间的差异，2) 证明从这种生物物理表征中产生的基本理解可以为生物加工应用合理选择结晶条件。结果表明，结晶条件（这两种条件均使 mAb 结晶为两种独特的晶体结构）会对 mAb 结构和溶液态生物物理性质产生截然不同的影响，从而导致蛋白质的热稳定性和胶体稳定性以及通过结晶作为单元操作纯化 mAb 的结果显着不同。其次，这项工作强调了单克隆抗体等大分子与咖啡因等小分子的共结晶可以极大地影响溶液稳定性和杂质剔除率。
第三，与上述相关，我们证明并非所有导致结构阐明的结晶条件都适合生物加工，因为某些溶液条件会对蛋白质溶液稳定性和构象、杂质共沉淀产生负面影响，从而导致复杂生物加工原料中杂质清除率降低。因此，对于生物加工应用，了解条件不仅对纯 mAb 的影响，而且对复杂溶液中的 mAb 和杂质的影响也至关重要。

42496057.title: Optimization strategies for monoclonal antibody production: advances in simulation and artificial intelligence in bioprocessing.
42496057.abstract: The rapid growth of monoclonal antibody (mAb) therapies has increased the need for efficient, scalable, and affordable manufacturing processes. However, mAb production remains complex because of nonlinear upstream cell culture behavior, expensive downstream purification, especially Protein-A chromatography, and plant-level bottlenecks that can increase cost, cycle time, and manuacturing uncertainty. This review examines recent developments in mAb manufacturing with focus on process simulation, mathematical optimization, and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) across upstream processing (USP), downstream processing (DSP), and integrated plant-level operation. In USP, media optimization, dynamic feeding, high-density cultures, and continuous perfusion bioreactors are discussed in relation to productivity and critical quality attributes (CQAs). In DSP, alternative and intensified purification strategies are reviewed with a focus on recovery, impurity clearance, scalability, cost, and technology maturity. AI/ML applications are also discussed from early-stage development and cell-line screening to upstream control, CQA prediction, chromatography optimization, and downstream decision support. Despite these advancements, challenges such as data heterogeneity, limited standardized datasets, model transferability, and regulatory constraints remain important barriers to implementation. Overall, this review uniquely connects simulation and AI/ML approaches to practical optimization across the full mAb manufacturing workflow, including design, scheduling, debottlenecking, purification, monitoring, and quality prediction. The combination of process simulation, continuous bioprocessing, and AI/ML-based decision support may enable more flexible, reliable, and cost-effective mAb manufacturing. However, these benefits depend on validation through robust models, process-specific case studies, and technoeconomic analysis.
42496057.affiliation: Department of Chemical and Petroleum Engineering, College of Engineering, UAE University, Al Ain, UAE.
42496057.title_zh: 单克隆抗体生产的优化策略：生物加工中模拟和人工智能的进展。
42496057.abstract_zh:
单克隆抗体 (mAb) 疗法的快速增长增加了对高效、可扩展且经济实惠的制造工艺的需求。然而，由于非线性上游细胞培养行为、昂贵的下游纯化（尤其是 Protein-A 层析）以及可能增加成本、周期时间和制造不确定性的工厂级瓶颈，mAb 生产仍然很复杂。本综述探讨了 mAb 制造的最新发展，重点关注上游加工 (USP)、下游加工 (DSP) 和集成工厂级操作的工艺模拟、数学优化和人工智能/机器学习 (AI/ML)。在 USP 中，讨论了与生产力和关键质量属性 (CQA) 相关的培养基优化、动态补料、高密度培养和连续灌注生物反应器。在 DSP 中，对替代和强化纯化策略进行了审查，重点是回收率、杂质清除、可扩展性、成本和技术成熟度。
还讨论了从早期开发和细胞系筛选到上游控制、CQA 预测、色谱优化和下游决策支持的 AI/ML 应用。尽管取得了这些进步，数据异构性、有限的标准化数据集、模型可转移性和监管限制等挑战仍然是实施的重要障碍。总体而言，本次综述独特地将模拟和 AI/ML 方法与整个 mAb 制造工作流程的实际优化联系起来，包括设计、调度、消除瓶颈、纯化、监控和质量预测。工艺模拟、连续生物工艺和基于人工智能/机器学习的决策支持的结合可以实现更灵活、可靠和更具成本效益的单克隆抗体制造。然而，这些好处取决于通过稳健的模型、特定流程的案例研究和技术经济分析进行验证。

42415423.title: Deep dive into drug substance HCP patterns for comprehensive safety assessment in recombinant mAb formats.
42415423.abstract: The presence of host cell proteins (HCPs) as process-related impurities in monoclonal antibody (mAb) therapeutics presents risks, including immunogenicity, product instability, and reduced therapeutic efficacy. Therefore, HCP levels are seen as a critical quality attribute which requires monitoring. Characterization of residual HCPs is essential during process development and after process changes in late project phases including post-submission changes. Mass spectrometry-based analysis of HCPs is increasingly employed to overcome the limitations of ELISAs, particularly in identifying individual low-abundance HCPs. In this study, we systematically compared three enrichment strategies: hexapeptide enrichment, immunoaffinity chromatography (IAC), and native digest (ND), to enhance LC-MS/MS-based detection of low-abundance HCPs across five recombinant products expressed in CHO cells. Our results show that both ND and IAC substantially expand HCP detection beyond hexapeptide enrichment and in-solution digest in total number of HCP identification. While IAC supported the detection of several potentially critical HCPs, ND uniquely identified additional low-abundance HCPs not captured by antibody-based methods. Furthermore, pull-down assays revealed product-specific HCPs likely interacting with the active pharmaceutical ingredient, suggesting that standard purification steps may be insufficient for their removal. Together, our findings emphasize the complementary nature of ND and IAC for in-depth HCP profiling. We propose the combined application of both methods to ensure comprehensive detection of potentially critical HCPs in biopharmaceutical products, particularly when facing issues with low product or polysorbate stability caused by HCPs with enzymatic activities. This integrative approach supports enhanced product safety and control of consistent HCP depletion in the process.
42415423.affiliation: Analytical Development, ProtaGene GmbH, Dortmund, Germany.
42415423.title_zh: 深入研究原料药 HCP 模式，以对重组 mAb 形式进行全面的安全性评估。
42415423.abstract_zh:
单克隆抗体 (mAb) 疗法中宿主细胞蛋白 (HCP) 作为工艺相关杂质的存在存在风险，包括免疫原性、产品不稳定和治疗功效降低。因此，HCP 水平被视为需要监测的关键质量属性。残留 HCP 的表征在工艺开发期间以及项目后期阶段的工艺变更后（包括提交后变更）至关重要。基于质谱的 HCP 分析越来越多地用于克服 ELISA 的局限性，特别是在识别个体低丰度 HCP 方面。在本研究中，我们系统地比较了三种富集策略：六肽富集、免疫亲和层析 (IAC) 和天然消化 (ND)，以增强基于 LC-MS/MS 对 CHO 细胞中表达的五种重组产物的低丰度 HCP 的检测。我们的结果表明，ND 和 IAC 都大大扩展了 HCP 检测范围，超出了六肽富集和溶液内消化的 HCP 识别总数。
虽然 IAC 支持检测几种潜在的关键 HCP，但 ND 独特地识别了基于抗体的方法未捕获的其他低丰度 HCP。此外，下拉分析显示产品特异性 HCP 可能与活性药物成分相互作用，这表明标准纯化步骤可能不足以去除它们。总之，我们的研究结果强调了 ND 和 IAC 在深入 HCP 分析方面的互补性。我们建议结合应用这两种方法，以确保全面检测生物制药产品中潜在的关键 HCP，特别是在面临由具有酶活性的 HCP 引起的产品或聚山梨酯稳定性低的问题时。这种综合方法支持增强产品安全性并控制流程中一致的 HCP 消耗。

42415185.title: Application of commercial ultrafiltration membranes for protein purification by high performance countercurrent membrane purification (HPCMP).
42415185.abstract: High performance countercurrent membrane purification (HPCMP) has emerged as a promising diffusive separation strategy for the purification of recombinant proteins and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). However, prior studies employed dialysis membranes, which are designed for diffusive separations but have not been validated for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. This study evaluates the ability of commercial ultrafiltration (UF) membranes, engineered for pressure-driven filtration, to support highly selective diffusive separations. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis of the membrane cross-sections revealed marked morphological differences between UF and dialysis membranes. Yet, transport studies using polydisperse dextrans and model proteins demonstrated that UF membranes can deliver exceptional diffusive separation selectivity. In particular, a 100 kDa polysulfone membrane (Cytiva) provided >150-fold diffusive selectivity between bovine serum albumin (BSA) and immunoglobulin G (IgG). When utilized for mAb separation from a clarified CHO cell culture fluid, this membrane achieved >98% product yield, near-complete removal of low molecular weight species, and significant reduction in both DNA and host cell protein (HCP) levels. These results demonstrate that commercial UF membranes that are validated for bioprocessing applications can be repurposed for HPCMP, enabling scalable, continuous downstream processing of biotherapeutics.
42415185.affiliation: Department of Chemical Engineering, The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, Pennsylvania, USA.
42415185.title_zh: 应用商用超滤膜通过高性能逆流膜纯化 (HPCMP) 进行蛋白质纯化。
42415185.abstract_zh:
高性能逆流膜纯化 (HPCMP) 已成为一种有前景的扩散分离策略，用于纯化重组蛋白和单克隆抗体 (mAb)。然而，先前的研究采用了透析膜，该膜是为扩散分离而设计​​的，但尚未在生物制药制造中得到验证。本研究评估了专为压力驱动过滤而设计的商用超滤 (UF) 膜支持高选择性扩散分离的能力。膜横截面的扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 分析显示超滤膜和透析膜之间存在显着的形态差异。然而，使用多分散葡聚糖和模型蛋白的传输研究表明，超滤膜可以提供卓越的扩散分离选择性。特别是，100 kDa 聚砜膜 (Cytiva) 在牛血清白蛋白 (BSA) 和免疫球蛋白 G (IgG) 之间提供 >150 倍的扩散选择性。
当用于从澄清的 CHO 细胞培养液中分离 mAb 时，该膜实现了 >98% 的产物收率，几乎完全去除了低分子量物质，并显着降低了 DNA 和宿主细胞蛋白 (HCP) 水平。这些结果表明，经过生物加工应用验证的商用超滤膜可以重新用于 HPCMP，从而实现生物治疗药物的可扩展、连续的下游加工。

42235435.title: Advanced modeling techniques in hydrophobic interaction chromatography (HIC).
42235435.abstract: Hydrophobic Interaction Chromatography (HIC) is widely used in biopharmaceutical downstream processing for protein separation under mild and aqueous conditions. Accurate modeling of HIC for optimizing monoclonal antibody (mAb) monomer and aggregate separation remains challenging, primarily due to complex resin-protein interactions across diverse operating ranges. This study compares five advanced modeling approaches, mechanistic models, residual-based and differential parallel hybrid models, a serial hybrid model, and a physics informed neural network (PINN), to predict HIC behavior under varied conditions. Model performance was evaluated using qualitative trend analysis and quantitative metrics (R², RMSE, MBE). Among the tested approaches, the differential parallel hybrid model consistently demonstrated superior performance, accurately capturing the complex dynamics of HIC, including breakthrough, plateau, wash, and tailing phases for both monomer and aggregate species. It achieved remarkable accuracy for aggregate predictions (R² = 0.99, RMSE = 0.02, MBE = 0.01) and similarly strong performance for monomer (R² = 0.99). These findings underscore that sophisticated hybrid modeling strategies, especially the differential parallel approach, offer robust and highly accurate predictive capabilities essential for optimizing complex downstream bioprocesses like HIC.
42235435.affiliation: Process Engineering and Analytics, GSK R&D, Upper Providence, PA, USA. Electronic address: samira.x.beyramysoltan@gsk.com.
42235435.title_zh: 疏水相互作用色谱 (HIC) 的先进建模技术。
42235435.abstract_zh:
疏水相互作用色谱 (HIC) 广泛应用于生物制药下游加工，用于在温和的水性条件下分离蛋白质。用于优化单克隆抗体 (mAb) 单体和聚集体分离的 HIC 精确建模仍然具有挑战性，这主要是由于不同操作范围内复杂的树脂-蛋白质相互作用。本研究比较了五种先进的建模方法、机械模型、基于残差和差分的并行混合模型、串行混合模型和物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，以预测不同条件下的 HIC 行为。使用定性趋势分析和定量指标（R²、RMSE、MBE）评估模型性能。在测试的方法中，微分并行混合模型始终表现出卓越的性能，准确捕捉 HIC 的复杂动态，包括单体和聚集体的突破、稳定、洗涤和拖尾阶段。它在总体预测方面取得了显着的准确性（R² = 0.99，RMSE = 0.02，MBE = 0.01），并且在单体预测方面也取得了同样出色的性能（R² = 0.99）。
这些发现强调，复杂的混合建模策略，尤其是微分并行方法，提供了强大且高度准确的预测能力，对于优化 HIC 等复杂的下游生物过程至关重要。

42013000.title: Reduction and denaturation before affinity chromatography for host cell protein removal in aggregate-rich monoclonal antibody.
42013000.abstract: Host cell proteins (HCPs) are important process-related safety concern factors during drug development, clinical trials and manufacturing, and their removal becomes particularly challenging when associated with antibody aggregates. Residual HCPs in drug products could trigger adverse effects or compromise drug efficacy and stability. This study aims to enhance the HCP removal specifically in monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) with high aggregate content before protein A chromatography by introducing reduction and denaturation steps. A model mAb was purified by different processes, and the impact on HCP removal was evaluated by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS). The HCP profiles in high aggregate, low aggregate and monomeric mAbs were analyzed by LC-MS. The additional reduction and denaturation steps improved HCP removal rate by 1.08 log10 reduction value (LRV) compared to the control process. For the relatively abundant high-risk HCPs, 45% were completely removed. HCP removal in the model mAb was significantly enhanced, especially in high aggregate forms. This method can reduce HCP carry-over from mAbs aggregates in subsequent downstream processing and can provide an efficient HCP removal strategy for manufacturing to improve patient safety and drug stability.
42013000.affiliation: RemeGen Co., Ltd, Yantai, Shandong, China.
42013000.title_zh: 在亲和层析之前进行还原和变性，以去除富含聚集体的单克隆抗体中的宿主细胞蛋白。
42013000.abstract_zh:
宿主细胞蛋白 (HCP) 是药物开发、临床试验和制造过程中重要的与过程相关的安全问题因素，当与抗体聚集体相关时，它们的去除变得特别具有挑战性。药品中残留的 HCP 可能会引发不良反应或损害药物疗效和稳定性。本研究旨在通过引入还原和变性步骤，在 Protein A 层析之前增强聚集体含量高的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 中 HCP 的去除。通过不同的工艺纯化模型单克隆抗体，并通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）评估对HCP去除的影响。通过 LC-MS 分析高聚集、低聚集和单体 mAb 中的 HCP 谱。与对照过程相比，额外的还原和变性步骤将 HCP 去除率提高了 1.08 log10 还原值 (LRV)。对于相对丰富的高危医护人员，45%被完全清除。模型 mAb 中的 HCP 去除率显着增强，特别是在高聚集形式中。
该方法可以减少后续下游加工中 mAb 聚集体中的 HCP 残留，并可以为生产提供有效的 HCP 去除策略，以提高患者安全性和药物稳定性。

41903239.title: Accelerating chromatography process development: A hybrid approach to model hydrophobic interaction column based on high-throughput automated isotherm characterization.
41903239.abstract: In an industrial setting, the development of hydrophobic interaction chromatography (HIC) processes for protein purification is often time-consuming and resource-intensive, requiring extensive experimentation to optimize conditions for specific protein-resin systems. This study presents a hybrid modeling framework for hydrophobic interaction chromatography, which can be used in commercial chromatography process development to address these challenges. The hybrid model integrates mechanistic principles, including fluid dynamics and mass transfer from the lumped rate model, with data-driven binding isotherms derived using high-throughput experimental platforms. Fully automated systems such as slurry plates and micropipette tips are used to characterize binding isotherms across a two-dimensional parameter space of pH and salt concentration for a monoclonal antibody. The model's predictive accuracy is validated by comparing simulated chromatograms with experimental data for target monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and high molecular weight aggregates (HMWs). Mean squared errors of 0.45, 3.66, and 0.03 mg/mL for all proteins, target monomer, and HMW species are obtained with the proposed modelling methodology.
41903239.affiliation: Process Modeling and Data Sciences, Sanofi, Framingham MA, USA.
41903239.title_zh: 加速色谱工艺开发：基于高通量自动化等温线表征的疏水相互作用柱建模混合方法。
41903239.abstract_zh:
在工业环境中，用于蛋白质纯化的疏水相互作用层析 (HIC) 工艺的开发通常非常耗时且资源密集，需要进行大量实验来优化特定蛋白质-树脂系统的条件。本研究提出了疏水相互作用色谱的混合建模框架，可用于商业色谱工艺开发以应对这些挑战。该混合模型集成了机械原理，包括来自集总速率模型的流体动力学和质量传递，以及使用高通量实验平台导出的数据驱动的结合等温线。全自动系统（例如浆板和微量移液器吸头）用于表征单克隆抗体在 pH 和盐浓度二维参数空间中的结合等温线。通过将模拟色谱图与目标单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和高分子量聚集体 (HMW) 的实验数据进行比较，验证了模型的预测准确性。
使用所提出的建模方法获得所有蛋白质、目标单体和 HMW 物种的均方误差为 0.45、3.66 和 0.03 mg/mL。

42563142.title: An empirical single-breakthrough curve workflow for rapid early-phase development of continuous capture chromatography for monoclonal antibodies and mAb-derived proteins.
42563142.abstract: Continuous chromatography for Protein A capture of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and related biotherapeutics is gaining popularity for higher throughput and reduced costs but introduces challenges for development and modeling. We present a streamlined, single-breakthrough-curve approach that predicts maximum and operating binding capacities (MBC and OBC, respectively) for continuous Protein A chromatography of monoclonal antibodies and derivatives. Our empirically-calibrated model-intended for early-stage, material-limited process development-enables accurate OBC prediction (root mean squared error [RMSE]≤ 5% for four distinct proteins) using less than 1 g of protein. This approach reduces the experimental timeline by ~2 weeks and is best suited for rapid screening and initial process optimization, not full design-space determination. Results confirm the model's accuracy across molecules, with clear practical advantages for accelerating preclinical pipeline advancement.
42563142.affiliation: Biotherapeutics Process Development, Takeda Development Center Americas, Inc, Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA.
42563142.title_zh: 经验性单突破曲线工作流程，用于单克隆抗体和 mAb 衍生蛋白连续捕获色谱的快速早期开发。
42563142.abstract_zh: 用于捕获单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和相关生物治疗药物的 Protein A 连续色谱法因其更高的通量和更低的成本而越来越受欢迎，但也给开发和建模带来了挑战。我们提出了一种简化的单突破曲线方法，可预测单克隆抗体和衍生物的连续 Protein A 层析的最大和操作结合能力（分别为 MBC 和 OBC）。我们的经验校准模型适用于早期阶段、材料有限的工艺开发，可使用不到 1 g 的蛋白质进行准确的 OBC 预测（四种不同蛋白质的均方根误差 [RMSE]≤ 5%）。这种方法将实验时间缩短了约 2 周，最适合快速筛选和初始工艺优化，而不是完整的设计空间确定。结果证实了该模型在分子中的准确性，对于加速临床前管道的进展具有明显的实际优势。

42402251.title: Administration Study of Bedinvetmab, an Antinerve Growth Factor Monoclonal Antibody, in Horses for Doping Control Purposes.
42402251.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) targeting nerve growth factor (NGF) represent a novel therapeutic approach for managing acute and chronic pain in humans and animals. However, their potential misuse as pain-masking agents in competitive equine sports raises significant welfare and integrity concerns. To enhance understanding of the elimination profile of anti-NGF mAb if misused in horses, this study describes the first administration of bedinvetmab (a canine anti-NGF mAb) in three geldings, establishing its plasma elimination profile following subcutaneous administration. Bedinvetmab plasma concentrations were determined using a recently developed generic method involving affinity purification with Protein A magnetic beads, followed by tryptic digestion and identification of a proteotypic peptide via capillary flow high performance liquid chromatography coupled with high resolution tandem mass spectrometry (HPLC-HRMS). Significant interindividual variability was observed. Maximum plasma concentrations ranged from approximately 0.97 to 6.0 μg/mL and occurred 1-2 days post-administration. Bedinvetmab was detectable up to the last sampled time point (34 days) in two horses (estimated concentrations: 1.9 and 1.7 μg/mL), while in the third horse, it was detectable only up to 5 days post-administration (0.13 μg/mL). Although the mechanisms underlying this variability were unclear, these results demonstrate that mAbs developed for other species can exert prolonged effects in horses, underscoring the importance of implementing effective doping controls for the misuse of therapeutic mAbs.
42402251.affiliation: Racing Laboratory, The Hong Kong Jockey Club, Sha Tin Racecourse, Sha Tin, N. T, Hong Kong, China.
42402251.title_zh: Bedinvetmab（一种抗神经生长因子单克隆抗体）在马中用于兴奋剂控制目的的给药研究。
42402251.abstract_zh:
靶向神经生长因子 (NGF) 的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 代表了一种治疗人类和动物急性和慢性疼痛的新型治疗方法。然而，它们在竞技马术运动中作为止痛剂的潜在滥用引起了重大的福利和诚信问题。为了加深对抗 NGF 单克隆抗体在马中误用的消除情况的了解，本研究描述了在三匹骟马中首次施用 bedinvetmab（一种犬类抗 NGF 单克隆抗体），建立了皮下注射后其血浆消除情况。使用最近开发的通用方法测定 Bedinvetmab 血浆浓度，该方法涉及使用 Protein A 磁珠进行亲和纯化，然后通过毛细管流高效液相色谱与高分辨率串联质谱 (HPLC-HRMS) 相结合进行胰蛋白酶消化和蛋白肽鉴定。观察到显着的个体差异。最大血浆浓度范围约为 0.97 至 6.0 μg/mL，发生在给药后 1-2 天。
直到最后采样时间点（34 天），在两匹马中均可检测到 Bedinvetmab（估计浓度：1.9 和 1.7 μg/mL），而在第三匹马中，仅在给药后 5 天才可检测到（0.13 μg/mL）。尽管这种变异性背后的机制尚不清楚，但这些结果表明，为其他物种开发的单克隆抗体可以对马产生长期影响，这强调了对治疗性单克隆抗体的滥用实施有效的兴奋剂控制的重要性。

42323147.title: From candidate ranking to lead identification - Hydrophobic interaction chromatography, PAIA, and structure-based calculations for hydrophobicity determination during developability assessment of mAbs and a mAb-derived fusion protein.
42323147.abstract: Antibody therapeutics have gained critical relevance in the treatment of numerous health conditions, yet their development is resource-intensive and bears a non-negligible failure risk. Consequently, developability assessment to predict a protein's likeliness to evolve into an approved drug has become a pivotal measure. Surface hydrophobicity is a crucial developability feature because of its relation to self-interaction and aggregation. In our study, we determined the hydrophobicity of 21 antibodies and one antibody-derived fusion protein by hydrophobic interaction chromatography (HIC), the emerging PAIA assay, and structure-based calculations. We derived data analysis concepts for PAIA and calculated surface descriptors by taking well-established HIC as reference. Based on these concepts and considering each technique's capabilities and limitations, we deduce how HIC, PAIA, and surface descriptors for hydrophobicity can efficiently be combined throughout the different developability assessment stages to meet material availability and required throughput and characterization depth. For discovery and early development, we illustrate the definition of in silico thresholds to identify low-risk candidates and reduce the initial candidate pool. We then show how data from 384-well plate-based PAIA screening can be used for the classification into low-, medium-, and high-hydrophobicity molecules, followed by the high-resolution hydrophobicity ranking of final lead candidate(s) by HIC.
42323147.journal: European journal of pharmaceutics and biopharmaceutics : official journal of Arbeitsgemeinschaft fur Pharmazeutische Verfahrenstechnik e.V
42323147.affiliation: Coriolis Pharma Research GmbH, Fraunhoferstr. 18 b, 82152 Martinsried, Germany. Electronic address: constanze.helbig@coriolis-pharma.com.
42323147.title_zh: 从候选排序到先导化合物鉴定 - 在 mAb 和 mAb 衍生融合蛋白的可开发性评估过程中，疏水相互作用色谱、PAIA 和基于结构的疏水性计算。
42323147.abstract_zh:
抗体疗法在许多健康状况的治疗中已经获得了至关重要的相关性，但其开发是资源密集型的，并且具有不可忽视的失败风险。因此，预测蛋白质演变成批准药物的可能性的可开发性评估已成为一项关键措施。表面疏水性是一个重要的可开发性特征，因为它与自相互作用和聚集有关。在我们的研究中，我们通过疏水相互作用层析 (HIC)、新兴的 PAIA 测定和基于结构的计算确定了 21 种抗体和一种抗体衍生融合蛋白的疏水性。我们以成熟的 HIC 为参考，导出了 PAIA 的数据分析概念并计算了表面描述符。基于这些概念并考虑每种技术的能力和局限性，我们推断出如何在不同的可开发性评估阶段有效地组合 HIC、PAIA 和疏水性表面描述符，以满足材料可用性和所需的通量和表征深度。
对于发现和早期开发，我们说明了计算机阈值的定义，以识别低风险候选者并减少初始候选者库。然后，我们展示了如何使用基于 384 孔板的 PAIA 筛选数据将分子分类为低、中和高疏水性分子，然后通过 HIC 对最终主要候选物进行高分辨率疏水性排名。

42216916.title: A Multitechnique Spectroscopy Platform for Monitoring Heterogeneities in the Higher-Order Structure of mAb Therapeutics.
42216916.abstract: Comprehensive characterization of higher-order structure (HOS) is a regulatory prerequisite for monoclonal antibody (mAb) therapeutics, particularly in establishing biosimilarity. A significant analytical challenge lies in detecting the early onset of structural heterogeneity within bulk drug substances, where signal dilution often masks precursor states of degradation. This study proposes a novel, multitechnique spectroscopy platform consisting of UV-vis, Far-UV circular dichroism, intrinsic and extrinsic fluorescence, and Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy coupled with chemometrics for monitoring heterogeneities in HOS during the thermal degradation of trastuzumab, an IgG1mAb therapeutic. While size exclusion chromatography (SEC) confirmed a progressive, monotonic accumulation of soluble aggregates, the proposed multitechnique spectroscopic platform yielded richer information. Intrinsic and extrinsic fluorescence identified an early conformational drift characterized by tertiary core destabilization and hydrophobic exposure immediately upon thermal stress (<1 h), well before the onset of global backbone unfolding detected by circular dichroism. Data fusion via principal component analysis (PCA), biplot, and dendrogram allowed for a more nuanced understanding of the HOS evolution through the thermal stress timeline. The data-fusion approach explained in this study offers a robust, high-resolution framework for monitoring structural consistency through direct HOS mapping, offering a powerful solution for monitoring the quality of biotherapeutic products during stability studies as well as for biosimilarity assessments.
42216916.affiliation: Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi 110016, India.
42216916.title_zh: 用于监测 mAb 疗法高阶结构异质性的多技术光谱平台。
42216916.abstract_zh:
高阶结构 (HOS) 的综合表征是单克隆抗体 (mAb) 治疗的监管先决条件，特别是在建立生物相似性方面。一个重大的分析挑战在于检测原料药内结构异质性的早期发生，其中信号稀释通常掩盖了降解的前体状态。本研究提出了一种新颖的多技术光谱平台，包括紫外-可见光、远紫外圆二色性、内在和外在荧光、傅里叶变换红外 (FTIR) 光谱以及化学计量学，用于监测 IgG1mAb 治疗剂曲妥珠单抗热降解过程中 HOS 的异质性。虽然尺寸排阻色谱 (SEC) 证实了可溶性聚集体的渐进、单调积累，但所提出的多技术光谱平台产生了更丰富的信息。内在和外在荧光识别出早期构象漂移，其特征是热应力后（<1小时）立即发生三级核心不稳定和疏水暴露，远早于圆二色性检测到的整体主链展开开始。
通过主成分分析 (PCA)、双图和树状图进行数据融合，可以更细致地了解 HOS 通过热应力时间线的演变。本研究中解释的数据融合方法提供了一个强大的高分辨率框架，用于通过直接 HOS 映射来监测结构一致性，为在稳定性研究期间监测生物治疗产品的质量以及生物相似性评估提供了强大的解决方案。

42204975.title: Engineering Secretory (S)IgA to Facilitate Affinity Purification for Large Scale Downstream Processing.
42204975.abstract: Secretory (S)IgA class antibodies play a vital role in first line immunological defence at mucosal surfaces. Passive immunisation with monoclonal SIgA antibodies could offer a completely novel application for a biologics market currently dominated by systemic IgG class monoclonal antibodies. Recent advances have made large scale manufacture of SIgA mAbs feasible, but downstream affinity purification remains a hurdle because IgA antibodies usually have poor affinity for Protein A, the most widely used affinity ligand for antibodies. This research addresses this problem by engineering chimaeric secretory component (SC), containing IgG Fc domains (CH2─CH3) which confer Protein A binding. SC is a component of SIgA and consists of five immunoglobulin-like domains. We demonstrate that expressing recombinant monoclonal SIgA with SC domains D2-D3 or D3-D4 replaced by IgG Fc domains (CH2─CH3) enables Protein A affinity purification of SIgA, without affecting antibody assembly or antigen binding functionality. Inserting the Protein A binding site into SC, results in purification of SIgA and free SC, which could then be separated according to size, but importantly not SIgA assembly intermediates such as dimeric IgA, that has a similar molecular size to SIgA. The use of SC-Fc fusions could streamline SIgA mAb purification and unlock their clinical potential.
42204975.affiliation: Hotung Molecular Immunology Laboratory, Institute for Infection and Immunity, School of Health and Medical Sciences, City St. George's University of London, London, UK.
42204975.title_zh: 工程化分泌 (S)IgA 以促进大规模下游处理的亲和纯化。
42204975.abstract_zh:
分泌型 (S)IgA 类抗体在粘膜表面的一线免疫防御中发挥着至关重要的作用。单克隆 SIgA 抗体的被动免疫可以为目前由全身 IgG 类单克隆抗体主导的生物制剂市场提供全新的应用。最近的进展使得大规模生产 SIgA mAb 成为可能，但下游亲和纯化仍然是一个障碍，因为 IgA 抗体通常对蛋白 A（抗体最广泛使用的亲和配体）的亲和力较差。本研究通过设计嵌合分泌成分 (SC) 来解决这个问题，其中含有 IgG Fc 结构域 (CH2─CH3)，可赋予 Protein A 结合能力。 SC 是 SIgA 的组成部分，由五个免疫球蛋白样结构域组成。我们证明，用 IgG Fc 结构域 (CH2─CH3) 替换 SC 结构域 D2-D3 或 D3-D4 表达重组单克隆 SIgA 可以实现 SIgA 的 Protein A 亲和纯化，而不影响抗体组装或抗原结合功能。
将 Protein A 结合位点插入 SC，可纯化 SIgA 和游离 SC，然后可以根据大小进行分离，但重要的是不能分离 SIgA 组装中间体，例如二聚体 IgA，其分子大小与 SIgA 相似。 SC-Fc 融合的使用可以简化 SIgA mAb 的纯化并释放其临床潜力。

42192004.title: Development and preliminary physicochemical characterization of a Ramucirumab biosimilar candidate in CHO cells using shake-flask fed-batch culture.
42192004.abstract: The development of biosimilar monoclonal antibodies requires strict control of critical quality attributes and a detailed understanding of cell culture performance. This study describes the development and preliminary physicochemical characterization of a candidate biosimilar monoclonal antibody targeting VEGFR-2 produced in CHO cells. Seventy-five clones generated through gene transfection were screened based on productivity and cell viability. Culture parameters including pH, glucose concentration, cell growth, and cell specific productivity (Qp) were monitored to evaluate their influence on production performance. Eight high producing clones were selected for shake-flask scale fed-batch production. The lead clone achieved a final titer of 2.79 g/L. The biosimilar candidates were characterized using intact mass spectrometry, size exclusion chromatography, cation exchange chromatography, hydrophobic interaction chromatography, glycan analysis, and peptide mapping. Binding affinities were evaluated using SPR, demonstrating comparable interaction with VEGFR-2. The analytical results demonstrated structural similarity to the reference product with no critical differences in purity, charge variants, glycosylation patterns, or binding affinity. These findings demonstrate the importance of systematic clone screening and upstream process monitoring for achieving consistent product quality in biosimilar antibody production and provide practical insights for mammalian cell-based bioprocess development.
42192004.affiliation: Izmir International Biomedicine and Genome Institute, Dokuz Eylul University, Izmir, Turkey.
42192004.title_zh: 使用摇瓶补料分批培养在 CHO 细胞中开发雷莫芦单抗候选生物类似药并进行初步理化表征。
42192004.abstract_zh:
生物仿制药单克隆抗体的开发需要严格控制关键质量属性并详细了解细胞培养性能。本研究描述了 CHO 细胞中产生的针对 VEGFR-2 的候选生物仿制药单克隆抗体的开发和初步理化特性。根据生产力和细胞活力筛选了通过基因转染产生的 75 个克隆。监测包括 pH、葡萄糖浓度、细胞生长和细胞比生产率 (Qp) 在内的培养参数，以评估它们对生产性能的影响。选择八个高产克隆用于摇瓶规模补料分批生产。主要克隆的最终滴度为 2.79 g/L。使用完整质谱、尺寸排阻色谱、阳离子交换色谱、疏水相互作用色谱、聚糖分析和肽图谱对候选生物仿制药进行了表征。使用 SPR 评估结合亲和力，证明与 VEGFR-2 具有可比的相互作用。
分析结果表明与参考产品结构相似，在纯度、电荷变体、糖基化模式或结合亲和力方面没有重大差异。这些发现证明了系统克隆筛选和上游工艺监控对于在生物仿制药生产中实现一致的产品质量的重要性，并为基于哺乳动物细胞的生物工艺开发提供了实用的见解。

42084290.title: On-deck pH measurement with integrated feedback control on a micro-scale platform for monoclonal antibody low pH viral inactivation.
42084290.abstract: The increasing demand for efficient monoclonal antibody manufacturing has accelerated the adoption of high throughput process development (HTPD) platforms, which enable rapid, automated screening of downstream operations. However, the integration of non-chromatographic steps such as low pH viral inactivation (VI) within automated workflows remains limited, largely due to the absence of a micro-scale method for accurate, on-deck pH measurement and control. This study presents the development and implementation of an automated pH measurement and feedback control system using optical pH sensors immobilized within 96-well microplates. The approach enables non-invasive, real-time monitoring of pH across the acidic range required for VI and is fully compatible with standard liquid-handling platforms. Integration of a feedback control algorithm allowed autonomous acid and base addition to achieve precise target pH values during both acidification and neutralization phases. The method achieved strong agreement between measured and expected pH values following optimization of measurement conditions, including ionic strength adjustment. The system was further integrated with Sartobind® Q and cation exchange chromatography steps to demonstrate an end-to-end automated workflow. Systematic assessment of cation exchange chromatography performance under controlled loading conditions enabled direct visualization of separation behavior and early identification of sub-optimal operating regions, demonstrating the platform's capability to expand experimental space and accelerate mechanistic process understanding. This work establishes a micro-scale, fully automated downstream platform with pH control, bridging a critical technological gap and advancing the vision of an end-to-end HTPD system for biopharmaceutical purification.
42084290.affiliation: Department of Biochemical Engineering, University College London, London, UK.
42084290.title_zh: 在微型平台上进行带集成反馈控制的甲板 pH 测量，用于单克隆抗体低 pH 病毒灭活。
42084290.abstract_zh:
对高效单克隆抗体制造的需求不断增长，加速了高通量工艺开发 (HTPD) 平台的采用，该平台能够快速、自动筛选下游操作。然而，非色谱步骤（例如低 pH 病毒灭活 (VI)）在自动化工作流程中的集成仍然有限，这主要是由于缺乏精确的现场 pH 测量和控制的微尺度方法。本研究介绍了使用固定在 96 孔微孔板内的光学 pH 传感器开发和实施自动 pH 测量和反馈控制系统。该方法能够在 VI 所需的酸性范围内对 pH 值进行非侵入式实时监测，并且与标准液体处理平台完全兼容。反馈控制算法的集成允许自主添加酸和碱，以在酸化和中和阶段实现精确的目标 pH 值。在优化测量条件（包括离子强度调整）后，该方法在测量值和预期 pH 值之间实现了高度一致。
该系统进一步与 Sartobind® Q 和阳离子交换色谱步骤集成，以演示端到端自动化工作流程。在受控加载条件下对阳离子交换色谱性能进行系统评估，实现分离行为的直接可视化和次优操作区域的早期识别，证明该平台具有扩展实验空间和加速机械过程理解的能力。这项工作建立了一个具有 pH 控制功能的微型全自动下游平台，弥合了关键的技术差距，并推进了用于生物制药纯化的端到端 HTPD 系统的愿景。

42570623.title: A modeling framework for uncertainty quantification in filter-plate-based high-throughput screening of the chromatography partition coefficient.
42570623.abstract: High‑throughput screening (HTS) of chromatography partition coefficients (Kp) is widely used in protein purification process development, spanning applications with markedly different precision requirements. Despite this widespread use, quantitative guidance on how experimental uncertainty propagates through filter-plate-based Kp assays and informs key design decisions has been lacking. We present an experimentally calibrated Monte Carlo (MC) framework for uncertainty propagation in filter-plate-based Kp HTS, which quantifies overall uncertainty and identifies the dominant experimental error sources across purification‑relevant equilibrium regimes. The model is parameterized by characterization of the major sources of experimental errors in a monoclonal antibody (mAb) monomer case study on POROS XS cation‑exchange media and accurately reproduces the magnitude, heteroscedasticity, and plate‑to‑plate variability observed. Variance decomposition identifies uncertainty in resin slurry distribution and supernatant concentration measurements as the dominant contributors, accounting for ≈ 97 % of total Kp variance over the investigated range of ideal partition coefficients (Kp,ideal). The framework further enables quantitative evaluation of design choices: analysis of the liquid‑to‑solid phase ratio (β) reveals a clear trade‑off between measurement precision and protein material demand, allowing derivation of application‑specific phase ratio recommendations. Overall, this work provides a quantitative basis for uncertainty‑aware HTS design and more reliable Kp data for purification process development decisions and modeling.
42570623.affiliation: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), Institute of Engineering in Life Sciences, Section IV: Biomolecular Separation Engineering, Karlsruhe, Germany; Global Development CMC Biologicals, Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG, Biberach, Germany.
42570623.title_zh: 基于滤板的色谱分配系数高通量筛选中不确定性量化的建模框架。
42570623.abstract_zh:
色谱分配系数 (Kp) 的高通量筛选 (HTS) 广泛用于蛋白质纯化工艺开发，涵盖精度要求明显不同的应用。尽管使用广泛，但仍缺乏关于实验不确定性如何通过基于滤板的 Kp 测定传播并为关键设计决策提供信息的定量指导。我们提出了一个经过实验校准的蒙特卡罗 (MC) 框架，用于基于滤板的 Kp HTS 中的不确定性传播，该框架量化了总体不确定性并识别了纯化相关平衡状态中的主要实验误差源。该模型通过对 POROS XS 阳离子交换介质上的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 单体案例研究中实验误差主要来源的表征进行参数化，并准确再现观察到的大小、异方差性和板间变异性。方差分解将树脂浆料分布和上清液浓度测量的不确定性确定为主要因素，占理想分配系数 (Kp,ideal) 研究范围内总 Kp 方差的约 97%。
该框架进一步实现了设计选择的定量评估：液固相比 (β) 的分析揭示了测量精度和蛋白质材料需求之间的明确权衡，从而可以得出针对特定应用的相比建议。总体而言，这项工作为不确定性 HTS 设计提供了定量基础，并为纯化工艺开发决策和建模提供了更可靠的 Kp 数据。

42470740.title: MS-compatible hydrophobic interaction chromatography of intact proteins using long-ligand stationary phases.
42470740.abstract: Hydrophobic interaction chromatography (HIC) is essential for the separation of proteins under native, nondenaturing conditions; however, traditional methods rely on high concentrations of nonvolatile kosmotropic salts that are incompatible with direct mass spectrometry (MS) coupling. This study evaluates a series of amide-based HIC stationary phases with extended ligands from propyl (C3) to decyl (C10) to overcome this bottleneck. Utilizing UHPLC hardware with titanium frits to mitigate detrimental metal-analyte interactions, we examined retention behavior for the NIST IgG1 monoclonal antibody and a diverse set of structurally heterogeneous top-down proteomic (TDP) targets ranging from 9.1 to 68 kDa. Drawing on the salt-exclusion principle, we demonstrate that increasing ligand length enables stationary phases to reach critical hydrophobicity at significantly lower salt concentrations, effectively offsetting the weaker retention forces of volatile, MS-friendly salts. While industry-standard propyl (C3) ligands failed completely to retain proteins at 0.5 M ammonium acetate, the decyl (C10) phase provided baseline resolution of the complex six-protein mixture. Furthermore, reaching critical hydrophobicity at lower salt levels relaxes the suppression of weak secondary interactions, such as hydrogen bonding via the ligand's amide-based carbonyl groups, which contributes to enhanced selectivity. Distinct retention dynamics were observed: while mAb retention plateaus at the octyl (C8) length, complex intact proteins like Protein G exhibit a near-linear retention increase across the entire series. Native HIC-LC-MS analysis of Protein G revealed consistent charge state distributions across short (C3) and long (C10) ligand conditions, indicating preservation of native-like structure even under increasing organic modifier during elution. These results demonstrate that long-ligand HIC phases maintain native protein structure while providing the necessary retention for direct HIC-MS coupling and the integration of HIC into multidimensional workflows for the identification of low-abundance proteoforms.

42470740.title_zh: 使用长配体固定相对完整蛋白质进行 MS 兼容的疏水相互作用色谱。
42470740.abstract_zh:
疏水相互作用色谱 (HIC) 对于在天然、非变性条件下分离蛋白质至关重要；然而，传统方法依赖于高浓度的非挥发性亲液盐，这与直接质谱 (MS) 耦合不相容。本研究评估了一系列基于酰胺的 HIC 固定相，其配体从丙基 (C3) 延伸到癸基 (C10)，以克服这一瓶颈。利用带有钛熔块的 UHPLC 硬件来减轻有害的金属-分析物相互作用，我们检查了 NIST IgG1 单克隆抗体和多种结构异质自上而下蛋白质组 (TDP) 靶标的保留行为，范围从 9.1 到 68 kDa。利用盐排斥原理，我们证明增加配体长度可以使固定相在盐浓度显着降低的情况下达到临界疏水性，从而有效抵消挥发性、MS 友好盐的较弱保留力。虽然行业标准的丙基 (C3) 配体在 0.5 M 醋酸铵中完全无法保留蛋白质，但癸基 (C10) 相提供了复杂的六蛋白质混合物的基线分辨率。
此外，在较低盐水平下达到临界疏水性可以缓解对弱次级相互作用的抑制，例如通过配体的酰胺基羰基形成氢键，这有助于提高选择性。观察到了独特的保留动态：虽然 mAb 保留在辛基 (C8) 长度处达到平台，但复杂的完整蛋白质（如 Protein G）在整个系列中表现出近线性的保留增加。蛋白 G 的天然 HIC-LC-MS 分析揭示了短 (C3) 和长 (C10) 配体条件下一致的电荷态分布，表明即使在洗脱过程中有机改性剂增加的情况下，仍保留了类似天然的结构。这些结果表明，长配体 HIC 相保持了天然蛋白质结构，同时为直接 HIC-MS 耦合和将 HIC 集成到多维工作流程中提供了必要的保留，以鉴定低丰度的蛋白质形式。

42368154.title: Characterization of the Anti-Alzheimer Drug Lecanemab by Mass Spectrometry.
42368154.abstract: Lecanemab is a humanized mouse monoclonal antibody that is clinically approved for treating Alzheimer's disease by binding to amyloid oligomers, protofibrils, and insoluble fibrils to clear Aβ aggregates in the brain. Although therapeutically effective, lecanemab is also associated with side effects, and its quality might vary among different batches due to impurities and modifications. Herein, we provide proteomics, intact protein, and N-glycoproteomics analyses of lecanemab by liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry. We found that the lecanemab drug is highly pure but displays two major peaks in the chromatography and contains many species with close molecular weights around 150 kDa under mass spectrometric scanning. There were 40 N-glycans found at the N304 site of lecanemab of the heavy chain. Further analysis by MSFragger identified other modifications and additional glycosites. These results provide data as resource for the identification of critical quality attributes of lecanemab in studying its therapeutic effectiveness, side effects, and possible batch-to-batch qualities.

42368154.title_zh: 通过质谱法表征抗阿尔茨海默病药物 Lecanemab。
42368154.abstract_zh: Lecanemab 是一种人源化小鼠单克隆抗体，经临床批准可通过与淀粉样蛋白寡聚物、原纤维和不溶性原纤维结合来清除大脑中的 Aβ 聚集物来治疗阿尔茨海默病。虽然乐卡奈单抗具有治疗效果，但也存在副作用，而且由于杂质和修饰，不同批次的质量可能会有所不同。在此，我们通过液相色谱结合质谱法对 Lecanemab 进行蛋白质组学、完整蛋白质和 N-糖蛋白质组学分析。我们发现lecanemab药物纯度很高，但在色谱中显示出两个主峰，并且在质谱扫描下含有许多分子量接近的物质，约为150 kDa。在lecanemab重链的N304位点发现了40个N-聚糖。 MSFragger 的进一步分析确定了其他修饰和额外的糖位点。这些结果为识别 Lecanemab 的关键质量属性提供了数据资源，以研究其治疗效果、副作用和可能的批次质量。

42346963.title: Separation of Monoclonal Antibody Aggregates Using an Analytical Ultrafiltration Technique.
42346963.abstract: Size exclusion chromatography is the industry-standard method for measuring aggregate content in monoclonal antibody samples. In this paper, we present an orthogonal analytical technique based on ultrafiltration for detecting and quantifying monoclonal antibody aggregates. The sample to be analyzed was injected into the system in the ultrafiltration mode, and the monomeric monoclonal antibody molecules were detected in the form of a permeate peak. The system was then switched to backflow mode, and the aggregates were recovered and detected in the form of a retained species peak. The aggregate content in a given sample was quantified based on the relative peak areas, akin to that in liquid chromatography. Two monoclonal antibodies were tested in this study using the proposed analytical ultrafiltration technique. Size exclusion chromatography served as the control technique. The data obtained using the two techniques were found to be in good agreement. The advantages and limitations of the proposed analytical ultrafiltration technique are discussed.
42346963.affiliation: Department of Chemical Engineering, McMaster University, 1280 Main Street West, Hamilton, ON L8S 4L7, Canada.
42346963.title_zh: 使用分析超滤技术分离单克隆抗体聚集体。
42346963.abstract_zh: 尺寸排阻色谱法是测量单克隆抗体样品中聚集体含量的行业标准方法。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于超滤的正交分析技术，用于检测和定量单克隆抗体聚集体。将待分析样品以超滤模式注入系统，以渗透峰的形式检测到单体单克隆抗体分子。然后将系统切换到回流模式，并以保留物质峰的形式回收和检测聚集体。给定样品中的聚集体含量根据相对峰面积进行定量，类似于液相色谱法。本研究使用所提出的分析超滤技术测试了两种单克隆抗体。尺寸排阻色谱法用作对照技术。使用这两种技术获得的数据被发现非常一致。讨论了所提出的分析超滤技术的优点和局限性。

42307050.title: Attenuation of Triple Selection Markers to Enhance mAb Expression in Tyrosine-Based Selection Systems via an Inducible CRISPRi Platform.
42307050.abstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells are the predominant host for monoclonal antibody (mAb) production, where the choice of selection system is critical. While metabolic selection systems are favored over antibiotic-based ones to avoid purification and safety issues, traditional single-marker systems poorly regulate the light-to-heavy chain (LC/HC) ratio, which is key for yield. Although novel multi-marker systems can address this, they often lack strategies to enhance expression. To overcome these limitations, our study employed a triple-marker system based on the tyrosine biosynthetic pathway to regulate the LC/HC ratio and eliminate the need for alkaline concentrated tyrosine feeding. Furthermore, we introduced an inducible CRISPR interference (iCRISPRi) platform, which integrates SV40 promoter-targeting CRISPRi with a Tet-on system, to enhance its efficiency. This strategy upregulated three fluorescent reporter genes, resulting in a selected mini-pool with 84.84% higher cell-specific productivity and 87.50% higher final titer in tyrosine-free perfusion culture. Mechanistically, doxycycline (Dox)-induced dCas9 expression inhibited the transcription of SV40-driven markers, enriching cells with high marker integration under tyrosine deprivation and consequently increasing HC and LC gene copy numbers to boost mAb yields. This iCRISPRi strategy serves as a potential enhancer for SV40 promoter-driven systems, offering novel insights for optimizing metabolic selection.

42307050.title_zh: 通过诱导型 CRISPRi 平台减弱三重选择标记以增强基于酪氨酸的选择系统中的 mAb 表达。
42307050.abstract_zh:
中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞是单克隆抗体 (mAb) 生产的主要宿主，其中选择系统的选择至关重要。虽然代谢选择系统比基于抗生素的系统更受青睐，以避免纯化和安全问题，但传统的单标记系统很难调节轻链与重链 (LC/HC) 的比率，而轻链与重链 (LC/HC) 的比率是产量的关键。尽管新型多标记系统可以解决这个问题，但它们通常缺乏增强表达的策略。为了克服这些限制，我们的研究采用了基于酪氨酸生物合成途径的三标记系统来调节 LC/HC 比率并消除对碱性浓缩酪氨酸喂养的需要。此外，我们引入了诱导型 CRISPR 干扰 (iCRISPRi) 平台，该平台将 SV40 启动子靶向 CRISPRi 与 Tet-on 系统集成，以提高其效率。该策略上调了三个荧光报告基因，导致选定的迷你库在无酪氨酸灌注培养中细胞比生产率提高了 84.84%，最终滴度提高了 87.50%。
从机制上讲，多西环素 (Dox) 诱导的 dCas9 表达抑制 SV40 驱动的标记物的转录，在酪氨酸剥夺下富集具有高标记物整合的细胞，从而增加 HC 和 LC 基因拷贝数，从而提高 mAb 产量。这种 iCRISPRi 策略可作为 SV40 启动子驱动系统的潜在增强剂，为优化代谢选择提供新的见解。

42276211.title: Stabilization of spray-dried monoclonal antibody formulations with polymeric excipients.
42276211.abstract: Spray drying is an emerging continuous manufacturing approach with significant potential for producing stable solid formulations of biologic drug products such as peptides, proteins and oligonucleotides. However, these sensitive molecules on exposure to thermal, shear, and interfacial stresses during spray drying may experience structural perturbations that compromise long-term stability. This study evaluated several polymeric excipients as stabilizers in spray-dried monoclonal antibody formulations and compared their performance with conventional sugar excipients, trehalose and mannitol. Formulations were prepared at a 1:1 (w/w) protein-to-excipient ratio and spray dried, and the resulting powders were subjected to accelerated storage at 40 °C. Particle size distribution, morphology, and residual moisture content were characterized. Protein physical stability and secondary structure were evaluated using size exclusion chromatography and solid-state Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, respectively. Solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy were used to study protein-excipient phase miscibility and particle surface composition, respectively, in the spray-dried solids. Hydrolyzed gelatin provided the most robust stabilization of the mAb, resulting in a fivefold reduction in monomer loss compared to trehalose after 90 days storage at 40 °C. (2-Hydroxypropyl)-β-cyclodextrin showed stabilization comparable to trehalose while reducing the mAb surface exposure. High molecular weight polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP K90) showed better mAb stabilization compared to its low molecular weight grade (PVP K30). Whereas dextran, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, and hydroxypropyl methylcellulose were less effective in their ability to stabilize the mAb. These findings highlight the critical role of excipient selection in improving the stability of spray-dried monoclonal antibody formulations.
42276211.affiliation: Department of Industrial and Molecular Pharmaceutics, College of Pharmacy, Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN 47907, USA.
42276211.title_zh: 使用聚合物赋形剂稳定喷雾干燥的单克隆抗体制剂。
42276211.abstract_zh:
喷雾干燥是一种新兴的连续生产方法，在生产肽、蛋白质和寡核苷酸等生物药品的稳定固体制剂方面具有巨大潜力。然而，这些敏感分子在喷雾干燥过程中暴露于热、剪切和界面应力时可能会经历结构扰动，从而损害长期稳定性。本研究评估了几种聚合物赋形剂作为喷雾干燥单克隆抗体制剂中的稳定剂，并将其与传统糖赋形剂、海藻糖和甘露醇的性能进行了比较。以 1:1 (w/w) 的蛋白质与赋形剂比例制备制剂并喷雾干燥，所得粉末在 40 °C 下加速储存。对粒度分布、形态和残余水分含量进行了表征。分别使用尺寸排阻色谱法和固态傅里叶变换红外光谱法评估蛋白质物理稳定性和二级结构。
固态核磁共振波谱和 X 射线光电子能谱分别用于研究喷雾干燥固体中的蛋白质-赋形剂相混溶性和颗粒表面组成。水解明胶为 mAb 提供了最强大的稳定性，与海藻糖相比，在 40 °C 储存 90 天后，单体损失减少了五倍。 (2-羟丙基)-β-环糊精表现出与海藻糖相当的稳定性，同时减少了 mAb 表面暴露。与其低分子量等级 (PVP K30) 相比，高分子量聚乙烯吡咯烷酮 (PVP K90) 显示出更好的 mAb 稳定性。而葡聚糖、羧甲基纤维素钠和羟丙基甲基纤维素稳定 mAb 的能力较差。这些发现强调了赋形剂选择在提高喷雾干燥单克隆抗体制剂稳定性方面的关键作用。

42214142.title: Exploiting ligand-driven salt selectivity for aggregate retention: enhancing monomer resolution on a high elution pH Protein A membrane.
42214142.abstract: Protein A chromatography often requires product-compromising low-pH conditions to remove monoclonal antibody aggregates. While recent high-pH ligands and membrane architectures have shown to improve aggregate clearance, the underlying mechanism of how the ligand and the matrix each contribute to this separation remains unclear. Here, we evaluated a recombinant high-pH Protein A prototype ligand immobilized on a Natrix membrane and a bead-based resin. We found that the addition of NaCl across a wide concentration range substantially enhanced monomer-aggregate resolution in a dose-dependent manner. Elevated ionic strength caused a slight shift in monomer elution toward milder conditions while simultaneously driving the tight retention of the aggregate subpopulation. At concentrations ≥ 0.5 M NaCl, aggregates were retained so strongly that they required complete salt removal under low-pH conditions to elute. Comparative evaluation proved this divergent selectivity is intrinsically driven by the recombinant ligand's specific binding response to salt, rather than being a mass-transport artifact of the membrane format. Leveraging this mechanism, we developed a stepwise elution strategy achieving > 70 % aggregate reduction and > 90 % monomer yield at pH 5.0, independent of initial aggregate burden. Additionally, a HIC-like flow-through mode confirmed the preferential retention of higher-order multimers. Ultimately, this work demonstrates that modulating ionic strength on engineered ligands establishes a highly tunable, mild-pH strategy for the robust purification of aggregation-prone therapeutics.
42214142.affiliation: Institute for Biochemistry, Technical University of Applied Sciences Mannheim, 68163 Mannheim, Germany.
42214142.title_zh: 利用配体驱动的盐选择性实现聚集体保留：提高高洗脱 pH Protein A 膜上的单体分辨率。
42214142.abstract_zh:
Protein A 层析通常需要损害产物的低 pH 条件来去除单克隆抗体聚集体。虽然最近的高 pH 配体和膜结构已证明可以提高聚集体清除率，但配体和基质如何促进这种分离的潜在机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们评估了固定在 Natrix 膜和珠基树脂上的重组高 pH 蛋白 A 原型配体。我们发现，在较宽的浓度范围内添加 NaCl，以剂量依赖性方式显着增强了单体-聚集体分辨率。离子强度的升高导致单体洗脱向更温和的条件轻微转变，同时推动聚集体亚群的紧密保留。当浓度 ≥ 0.5 M NaCl 时，聚集体被强烈保留，以至于需要在低 pH 条件下完全去除盐才能洗脱。比较评估证明，这种不同的选择性本质上是由重组配体对盐的特异性结合反应驱动的，而不是膜格式的质量传输伪影。
利用这一机制，我们开发了一种逐步洗脱策略，在 pH 5.0 时实现了 > 70 % 聚集体减少和 > 90 % 单体产率，与初始聚集体负荷无关。此外，类似 HIC 的流通模式证实了高阶多聚体的优先保留。最终，这项工作证明，调节工程配体的离子强度可以建立一种高度可调的温和 pH 策略，用于稳定纯化易聚集的治疗药物。

42155371.title: Monitoring disulfide scrambling of monoclonal antibody biologics using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry coupled to online electrochemical reduction.
42155371.abstract: Electrochemical flow-cell (EC) devices have been used to perform online reduction of disulfide bonds found in both peptides and full-length proteins. This study demonstrates the use of a liquid chromatography-EC-mass spectrometry (LC-EC-MS) platform to monitor disulfide scrambling in the therapeutic monoclonal antibody (mAb), casirivimab. As a first step, disulfide scrambling was artificially induced during enzymatic digestion at pH 8.5. EC-assisted online partial reduction was performed via a post-column reduction scheme. Retention time (RT) alignment was used to validate the composition of the parental disulfide linkage. Fingerprints of all potential disulfide-linked pairs were generated based on the results of partial reduction with no need for additional information on any of the specific parental species. The performance of partial reduction was evaluated by varying critical parameters, including EC-cell voltage and the sample loading amount. The improved performance allows us to capture low-level disulfide scrambling such as linkages involving the hinge region. Additionally, the LC-EC-MS platform is used to monitor site-specific disulfide scrambling progress under high pH stress condition. Samples with varying levels of disulfide scrambling were prepared by alkylating free cysteines at different time points during digestion to perform a time-course study. As a result, we successfully monitored scrambling level of 13 sites through MS1-level relative quantification as well as their free thiol species. Low level of disulfide scrambling across the casirivimab was captured at 0.5 hr time point. Overall, we demonstrated that the online LC-EC-MS platform provided us with significant insights into patterns of disulfide scrambling.
42155371.journal: Journal of pharmaceutical and biomedical analysis
42155371.affiliation: Analytical Chemistry Group, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc., 777 Old Saw Mill River Road, Tarrytown, NY 10591, United States.
42155371.title_zh: 使用液相色谱-质谱联用在线电化学还原监测单克隆抗体生物制剂的二硫键扰乱。
42155371.abstract_zh:
电化学流动池 (EC) 装置已用于在线还原肽和全长蛋白质中的二硫键。本研究展示了使用液相色谱-EC-质谱 (LC-EC-MS) 平台来监测治疗性单克隆抗体 (mAb) 卡西瑞单抗中的二硫键乱序。第一步，在 pH 8.5 的酶消化过程中人为诱导二硫键扰乱。通过柱后还原方案进行 EC 辅助在线部分还原。保留时间 (RT) 比对用于验证亲本二硫键的组成。所有潜在二硫键连接对的指纹都是根据部分还原的结果生成的，不需要任何特定亲本物种的额外信息。通过改变关键参数（包括 EC 电池电压和样品加载量）来评估部分还原的性能。改进的性能使我们能够捕获低水平的二硫键扰乱，例如涉及铰链区域的连接。
此外，LC-EC-MS 平台还可用于监测高 pH 胁迫条件下特定位点二硫键的扰乱进度。通过在消化过程中的不同时间点烷基化游离半胱氨酸来制备具有不同水平二硫键扰乱的样品，以进行时程研究。结果，我们通过 MS1 水平相对定量成功监测了 13 个位点的扰乱水平及其游离硫醇种类。在 0.5 小时时间点捕获到低水平的二硫键扰乱整个卡西里单抗。总的来说，我们证明了在线 LC-EC-MS 平台为我们提供了对二硫键扰乱模式的重要见解。

42043509.title: Resolving charge and glycosylation variants of cetuximab combining offline ion-exchange and hydrophilic interaction chromatography-HRMS.
42043509.abstract: Biopharmaceuticals, such as monoclonal antibodies (mAb), are complex molecules that require thorough analysis due to post-translational modifications, including charge variants and glycoform patterns. When analyzing intact mAbs, single liquid chromatography (LC) mass spectrometry (MS) methods often lack the resolution to distinguish this heterogeneity because they offer limited separation in both chromatographic and mass dimensions. Consequently, these methods struggle to detect low-abundance species, highlighting the importance of 2DLC-MS workflows. Here, we demonstrate the potential of the offline ion exchange chromatography (IEC)-hydrophilic interaction chromatography (HILIC)-MS method to effectively separate charge and glycoform variants of complex mAbs. Cetuximab served as the model antibody due to its multiple charge variants (arising from sialylation and C-terminal lysine clipping) and four glycosylation sites (in both Fab and Fc regions). Charge variants were first separated using non-volatile IEC and collected as individual fractions. These fractions were then analyzed using a low-flow HILIC-MS setup to increase sensitivity for low-abundance species. A RPLC trap column was used to desalt and reduce the volume transferred to the HILIC separation. The IEC-HILIC results showed that both Fc- and Fab-associated glycoforms of cetuximab were resolved to a level not achievable with HILIC-MS alone, allowing deeper insights into charge heterogeneity and glycosylation. In addition to resolving combined Fab/Fc glycoforms, the method also distinguished Fc-only glycoforms from the main isoform. This orthogonal IEC-HILIC method provides additional insights into charge and glycosylation heterogeneity, enabling a more comprehensive analysis of cetuximab. It provides an effective approach for detailed characterization of charge variations and glycoform diversity in next-generation protein therapeutics.

42043509.title_zh: 结合离线离子交换和亲水相互作用色谱-HRMS 解决西妥昔单抗的电荷和糖基化变体。
42043509.abstract_zh:
单克隆抗体 (mAb) 等生物制药是复杂的分子，由于翻译后修饰（包括电荷变体和糖型模式），需要进行彻底分析。在分析完整的 mAb 时，单一液相色谱 (LC) 质谱 (MS) 方法通常缺乏区分这种异质性的分辨率，因为它们在色谱和质量维度上提供的分离有限。因此，这些方法很难检测低丰度物种，这凸显了 2DLC-MS 工作流程的重要性。在这里，我们展示了离线离子交换色谱 (IEC)-亲水相互作用色谱 (HILIC)-MS 方法有效分离复杂 mAb 的电荷和糖型变体的潜力。西妥昔单抗因其多个电荷变体（由唾液酸化和 C 末端赖氨酸剪切产生）和四个糖基化位点（位于 Fab 和 Fc 区）而充当模型抗体。首先使用非挥发性 IEC 分离电荷变体并作为单独的分数收集。然后使用低流量 HILIC-MS 设置对这些组分进行分析，以提高对低丰度物种的灵敏度。
RPLC 捕获柱用于脱盐并减少转移至 HILIC 分离的体积。 IEC-HILIC 结果表明，西妥昔单抗的 Fc 和 Fab 相关糖型均被解析到单独使用 HILIC-MS 无法达到的水平，从而可以更深入地了解电荷异质性和糖基化。除了解析组合的 Fab/Fc 糖型外，该方法还将仅 Fc 糖型与主要亚型区分开来。这种正交 IEC-HILIC 方法提供了对电荷和糖基化异质性的额外见解，从而能够对西妥昔单抗进行更全面的分析。它为下一代蛋白质疗法中电荷变化和糖型多样性的详细表征提供了一种有效的方法。

42041385.title: The Multi-Attribute Method (MAM), An Advanced LC-MS Approach for Protein A Resin Performance and Lifecycle Evaluation.
42041385.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Protein A resins are indispensable for monoclonal antibody (mAb) production, yet their condition and performance are traditionally assessed using indirect or qualitative methods. In this study, the multi-attribute method (MAM), previously applied to therapeutic protein characterization, is systematically adapted for the first time as a unified liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) platform for Protein A resin analysis.
METHOD: Four Cytiva Protein A resins, MabSelect™, MabSelect SuRe™, MabSelect SuRe™ LX, and MabSelect™ PrismA, were evaluated by MAM for resin identity, Protein A ligand integrity, fouling by impurities, and cleaning performance.
RESULTS: MAM enables resin-specific peptide fingerprinting and quantitative monitoring of Protein A ligand post-translational modifications (PTMs), including deamidation, isomerization, and fragmentation induced by repeated clean-in-place (CIP) cycles. Comparative analysis of virgin and used resins revealed ligand degradation and fouling despite engineered alkaline stability, with MabSelect™ showing the greatest susceptibility. Importantly, residual monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and host cell proteins (HCPs) were directly detected and quantified from the resin matrix, providing a molecular-level assessment of resin cleaning effectiveness not achievable with conventional approaches.
CONCLUSIONS: This work establishes MAM as a novel, sensitive, and comprehensive strategy for Protein A resin lifecycle management, delivering actionable insight for resin selection, cleaning optimization, and downstream process development.

42041385.title_zh: 多属性方法 (MAM)，一种用于 Protein A 树脂性能和生命周期评估的先进 LC-MS 方法。
42041385.abstract_zh:
背景：Protein A 树脂对于单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的生产是不可或缺的，但传统上使用间接或定性方法评估其状况和性能。在这项研究中，之前应用于治疗性蛋白质表征的多属性方法 (MAM) 首次被系统地改编为统一的液相色谱-质谱 (LC-MS) 平台，用于蛋白质 A 树脂分析。
方法：MAM 对四种 Cytiva Protein A 树脂（MabSelect™、MabSelect SuRe™、MabSelect SuRe™ LX 和 MabSelect™ PrismA）评估树脂特性、Protein A 配体完整性、杂质污染和清洁性能。
结果：MAM 能够实现树脂特异性肽指纹分析和蛋白 A 配体翻译后修饰 (PTM) 的定量监测，包括重复原位清洗 (CIP) 循环引起的脱酰胺、异构化和片段化。对原始树脂和用过的树脂的比较分析显示，尽管设计了碱性稳定性，但配体降解和结垢，其中 MabSelect™ 显示出最大的敏感性。重要的是，可以直接从树脂基质中检测和定量残留的单克隆抗体（mAb）和宿主细胞蛋白（HCP），从而提供传统方法无法实现的树脂清洁效果的分子水平评估。
结论：这项工作将 MAM 确立为一种新颖、敏感且全面的 Protein A 树脂生命周期管理策略，为树脂选择、清洁优化和下游工艺开发提供可操作的见解。

42026710.title: Strategies for removing two "problematic" host cell proteins, using an "end-to-end" approach.
42026710.abstract: Host cell proteins (HCPs) are critical process-related impurities of recombinant protein biopharmaceuticals that have the potential to impact product safety and efficacy. In this study, two residual HCPs, heat shock protein 90 beta and perilipin-4-like, produced from a CHO cell line, were identified during the development of a late-stage platform Immunoglobulin G subclass 1 (IgG1) monoclonal antibody process. A risk assessment was performed that included identification of HCPs, homology with their human protein counterparts, and prior non-clinical and clinical experience. The outcome deemed these two species as "problematic" and target levels were established to guide approaches for removal. Given the high productivity of the upstream and downstream platform processes, the goal was to explore conditions that minimize deviations from the platform. An end-to-end approach was performed that evaluated downstream levers, including Protein A washes, polishing chromatography operational parameters, and exploration of depth filter media. Upstream levers were also explored, evaluating effects of temperature shift and modulation of iron and citrate to help control levels of both HCP species. The results presented in this study demonstrated the upstream and downstream conditions achieved effective removal of the two HCP species to meet drug substance targets.
42026710.affiliation: Process Biochemistry, Biogen, Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, USA.
42026710.title_zh: 使用“端到端”方法去除两种“有问题”的宿主细胞蛋白的策略。
42026710.abstract_zh:
宿主细胞蛋白 (HCP) 是重组蛋白生物制药中与工艺相关的关键杂质，有可能影响产品的安全性和功效。在这项研究中，在开发后期平台免疫球蛋白 G 亚类 1 (IgG1) 单克隆抗体过程期间，鉴定了由 CHO 细胞系产生的两种残留 HCP，即热休克蛋白 90 beta 和 perilipin-4 样。进行的风险评估包括 HCP 的鉴定、与其人类蛋白质对应物的同源性以及先前的非临床和临床经验。结果认为这两个物种是“有问题的”，并制定了目标水平来指导清除方法。鉴于上游和下游平台流程的高生产率，目标是探索最大限度地减少平台偏差的条件。采用端到端方法评估下游杠杆，包括 Protein A 清洗、精制色谱操作参数以及深度过滤介质的探索。还探索了上游杠杆，评估温度变化以及铁和柠檬酸盐调节的影响，以帮助控制两种 HCP 物种的水平。
本研究的结果表明，上游和下游条件可有效去除两种 HCP 物质，以满足原料药目标。

41930919.title: Optimization, Expression, Purification, and Activity Identification of Anti-PD-1 scFv.
41930919.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibodies have revolutionized cancer therapy but face challenges, including immune-related adverse events, poor tumor penetration due to their large size, and high production costs. Single-chain variable fragments offer a promising alternative, with enhanced tissue penetration and the potential for cost-effective prokaryotic expression.
METHODS: Based on the Opdivo sequence, an anti-PD-1 scFv (L2H5) was designed using a framework region-frequency-guided optimization approach. Two sites in the light chain and five in the heavy chain FR were mutated to high-frequency residues. The gene was codon-optimized for E. coli and cloned into the pET-28a vector. The protein was expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3), purified via Ni-NTA chromatography from inclusion bodies, and refolded by dialysis. Its bioactivity was assessed by immunoblotting, cytotoxicity assay, immunofluorescence, and a luciferase-based tumor cell killing assay.
RESULTS: The codon-optimized L2H5 scFv was successfully expressed, yielding 4 mg/L after purification. Immunoblotting confirmed its specific binding to PD-1. The CCK-8 assay demonstrated no significant cytotoxicity towards normal 293T cells. Immunofluorescence revealed specific binding to PD-1 on A549 cell surfaces. In a co-culture system with tumor cells and lymphocytes, the L2H5 scFv significantly enhanced T cell-mediated tumor cell killing in a dose- and time-dependent manner.
DISCUSSION: This study connected the VH and VL region sequences of the PD-1 monoclonal antibody drug Opdivo through a linker to form a PD-1 single-chain antibody and tried to mutate and optimize the protein sequence of the antibody framework region. The activity and binding of L2H5 PD-1 scFv to PD-1 protein were verified by in vitro experiments, and the binding ability of L2H5 PD-1 scFv to PD-1 protein was verified by immunoblotting and immunofluorescence. In terms of binding ability, the results of immunoblotting showed that the corresponding bands were detected at the size position of PD-1 protein, and the results of immunofluorescence intuitively showed the binding of L2H5 PD-1 scFv protein on cells. In terms of biological activity, the results of CCK-8 experiments showed that L2H5 PD-1 scFv had no obvious toxicity to normal cells and did not affect the growth and proliferation of normal cells.
CONCLUSION: The L2H5 anti-PD-1 scFv protein was successfully expressed by a prokaryotic vector. The expressed protein had no obvious toxicity to normal cells and retained PD-1-binding activity.

41930919.title_zh: 抗 PD-1 scFv 的优化、表达、纯化和活性鉴定。
41930919.abstract_zh:
简介：抗PD-1单克隆抗体彻底改变了癌症治疗，但面临着挑战，包括免疫相关的不良事件、由于体积大而导致的肿瘤渗透性差以及生产成本高。单链可变片段提供了一种有前途的替代方案，具有增强的组织渗透性和具有成本效益的原核表达的潜力。
方法：基于Opdivo序列，采用框架区域频率引导优化方法设计抗PD-1 scFv（L2H5）。轻链中的两个位点和重链FR中的五个位点突变为高频残基。该基因针对大肠杆菌进行了密码子优化，并克隆到 pET-28a 载体中。该蛋白在大肠杆菌 BL21(DE3) 中表达，通过 Ni-NTA 层析从包涵体中纯化，并通过透析重折叠。通过免疫印迹、细胞毒性测定、免疫荧光和基于荧光素酶的肿瘤细胞杀伤测定来评估其生物活性。
结果：密码子优化的L2H5 scFv成功表达，纯化后产量为4 mg/L。免疫印迹证实其与 PD-1 特异性结合。 CCK-8 测定表明对正常 293T 细胞没有显着的细胞毒性。免疫荧光显示 A549 细胞表面与 PD-1 特异性结合。在肿瘤细胞和淋巴细胞的共培养系统中，L2H5 scFv 以剂量和时间依赖性方式显着增强 T 细胞介导的肿瘤细胞杀伤作用。
讨论：本研究通过连接子将PD-1单克隆抗体药物Opdivo的VH和VL区序列连接起来，形成PD-1单链抗体，并尝试对抗体框架区的蛋白序列进行突变和优化。通过体外实验验证L2H5 PD-1 scFv与PD-1蛋白的结合能力，并通过免疫印迹和免疫荧光验证L2H5 PD-1 scFv与PD-1蛋白的结合能力。结合能力方面，免疫印迹结果显示在PD-1蛋白大小位置检测到相应条带，免疫荧光结果直观显示L2H5 PD-1 scFv蛋白与细胞的结合情况。生物活性方面，CCK-8实验结果表明，L2H5 PD-1 scFv对正常细胞无明显毒性，不影响正常细胞的生长和增殖。
结论：原核载体成功表达L2H5抗PD-1 scFv蛋白。表达的蛋白对正常细胞无明显毒性，并保留了PD-1结合活性。

41877579.title: Design of experiments-guided membrane capture facilitates integration of continuous virus inactivation using Phi6 as a surrogate virus in an intensified downstream process.
41877579.abstract: The growing demand for cost-efficient and flexible biomanufacturing has increased interest in process-intensified downstream platforms. This study evaluates an intensified monoclonal antibody (mAb) purification sequence, where two unit operations traditionally performed in batch mode-Protein A capture and low pH virus inactivation (VI)-are redesigned to enhance productivity and minimize resource usage. Rapid-cycling Protein A membrane chromatography was optimized using a design-of-experiments approach to address inherent membrane challenges such as buffer consumption. Wash step volumes were systematically reduced without compromising host cell protein or host cell DNA clearance, yielding a 70% reduction in total wash buffer consumption. At manufacturing scale, membrane adsorbers achieved critical quality attributes comparable to a benchmark resin, while increasing productivity ~20-fold and lowering capture-step costs. Protein A eluates were processed in a novel continuous virus inactivation (cVI) system using bacteriophage Phi6 as a surrogate for enveloped viruses. At residence times of 35 and 70 min, the cVI system achieved a ≥5-log reduction, equaling conventional batch performance without compromising mAb quality. The study demonstrates that membrane-based Protein A capture and continuous VI can be seamlessly integrated into an intensified DSP framework. This approach effectively maintains product quality while significantly reducing buffer usage and cost, thus supporting modular intensification strategies for clinical-scale mAb manufacturing.
41877579.affiliation: Department of Separation Technologies, Sartorius, Goettingen, Germany.
41877579.title_zh: 实验引导的膜捕获设计有助于使用 Phi6 作为替代病毒在强化的下游过程中整合连续病毒灭活。
41877579.abstract_zh:
对经济高效和灵活的生物制造的需求不断增长，增加了人们对工艺强化下游平台的兴趣。本研究评估了强化单克隆抗体 (mAb) 纯化序列，其中传统上以批处理模式执行的两个单元操作 - 蛋白 A 捕获和低 pH 病毒灭活 (VI) - 被重新设计，以提高生产率并最大限度地减少资源使用。使用实验设计方法对快速循环 Protein A 膜色谱进行了优化，以解决缓冲液消耗等固有的膜挑战。系统地减少洗涤步骤体积，而不影响宿主细胞蛋白质或宿主细胞 DNA 清除，使总洗涤缓冲液消耗量减少 70%。在制造规模上，膜吸附器实现了与基准树脂相当的关键质量属性，同时将生产率提高了约 20 倍并降低了捕获步骤成本。使用噬菌体 Phi6 作为包膜病毒的替代物，在新型连续病毒灭活 (cVI) 系统中处理 Protein A 洗脱液。
在 35 分钟和 70 分钟的停留时间下，cVI 系统实现了 ≥5 个对数的减少，与传统批次性能相当，且不影响 mAb 质量。该研究表明，基于膜的 Protein A 捕获和连续 VI 可以无缝集成到强化的 DSP 框架中。这种方法有效地保持了产品质量，同时显着减少了缓冲液的使用和成本，从而支持临床规模单克隆抗体制造的模块化强化策略。

42489360.title: On-Column Preparation of High-Performance Affinity Chromatography Columns.
42489360.abstract: We describe a custom preparation of high-performance affinity columns based on 3.5 μm nonporous polymeric particles covalently modified with streptavidin. The sorbent was packed into a 2.1 × 20 mm column hardware compatible with pressures up to 10,000 psi (68 MPa). Biotinylated affinity ligands were then immobilized on-column using a repetitive injection method until the streptavidin sorbent was saturated. The saturation was observed as a ligand breakthrough signal by ultraviolet detection. Column binding capacity of immobilized affinity ligands was estimated for d-biotin, biotinylated 25nt oligodeoxythymidine, and biotinylated anti-insulin mAb ligands. The prepared columns were used to quantify mRNA and insulin. Affinity column performance was evaluated in terms of binding capacity, calibration linearity range, and target analyte limit of quantitation. The high-performance streptavidin column is a platform for custom-made affinity chromatography device preparation, enabling routine quantitation of analytes of interest.
42489360.affiliation: Waters Corporation, Milford, Massachusetts 01757-3696, United States.
42489360.title_zh: 高性能亲和色谱柱的柱上制备。
42489360.abstract_zh: 我们描述了基于链霉亲和素共价修饰的 3.5 μm 无孔聚合物颗粒的高性能亲和柱的定制制备。将吸附剂装入 2.1 × 20 mm 的色谱柱硬件中，可承受高达 10,000 psi (68 MPa) 的压力。然后使用重复注射方法将生物素化的亲和配体固定在柱上，直到链霉亲和素吸附剂饱和。通过紫外检测观察到饱和度作为配体突破信号。评估了 d-生物素、生物素化 25nt 寡脱氧胸苷和生物素化抗胰岛素 mAb 配体的固定亲和配体的柱结合能力。准备好的柱用于定量 mRNA 和胰岛素。亲和柱性能根据结合能力、校准线性范围和目标分析物定量限进行评估。高性能链霉亲和素柱是用于定制亲和色谱装置制备的平台，可对感兴趣的分析物进行常规定量。

42450443.title: The Hapten Design, Monoclonal Antibody Preparation, and Immunoassay Development for Rapid Detection of Isofenphos-Methyl.
42450443.abstract: Isofenphos-methyl (IFP), a highly toxic and persistent organophosphate pesticide (OP), is widely used for soil pest control in crops but poses severe risks to ecological safety and human health because of its environmental accumulation and bioaccumulation. Herein, a sensitive and specific indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ic-ELISA) was developed for rapid IFP detection in vegetables. A novel IFP hapten was rationally designed and synthesized via computer-aided molecular simulation, and its structure was validated by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). High-specificity anti-IFP monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) with strong anti-matrix interference were prepared for the first time using a matrix effect-enhanced screening strategy. The optimized ic-ELISA showed high sensitivity, with an IC50 of 6.087 ng/mL and a detection range of 1.165-30.490 ng/mL, and no cross-reactivity with other common OPs. Spiked recovery experiments in celery and chili pepper matrices yielded recoveries of 81.87-97.95% (RSD < 5.44%), with highly consistent LC-MS/MS results. The method exhibited a weak positive matrix effect in vegetable matrices, eliminating complex pretreatment and enabling rapid onsite detection.
42450443.affiliation: National Nanfan Research Institute (Sanya), Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Sanya 572024, China.
42450443.title_zh: 用于快速检测甲基异苯磷的半抗原设计、单克隆抗体制备和免疫测定法开发。
42450443.abstract_zh:
甲基异苯磷（IFP）是一种高毒、持久性有机磷农药（OP），广泛用于农作物土壤害虫防治，但因其环境富集和生物富集而对生态安全和人类健康构成严重风险。本文开发了一种灵敏且特异的间接竞争酶联免疫吸附测定 (ic-ELISA)，用于快速检测蔬菜中的 IFP。通过计算机辅助分子模拟合理设计并合成了一种新型IFP半抗原，并通过液相色谱-串联质谱（LC-MS/MS）和核磁共振（NMR）对其结构进行了验证。采用基质效应增强筛选策略，首次制备了具有强抗基质干扰的高特异性抗IFP单克隆抗体（mAb）。优化后的ic-ELISA具有较高的灵敏度，IC50为6.087 ng/mL，检测范围为1.165-30.490 ng/mL，且与其他常见OP无交叉反应。芹菜和辣椒基质中的加标回收率实验的回收率为 81.87-97.95% (RSD < 5.44%)，且 LC-MS/MS 结果高度一致。
该方法在蔬菜基质中表现出微弱的正基质效应，无需复杂的预处理，可实现快速现场检测。

42376876.title: Computer-Aided Rational Hapten Design for Broad-Spectrum Monoclonal Antibody Development against Anthraquinones and Its Application in Lateral Flow Immunoassay.
42376876.abstract: Plant-derived foods are a vital component of the human diet, but they pose health risks due to the potential presence of anthraquinones (AQs) and their derivatives, and long-term intake of these substances can lead to health issues. Therefore, there is an urgent need for a method to rapidly and simultaneously detect seven AQs, including AQ, emodin, rhein, chrysophanol, aloe emodin, alizarin, and purpurin. In this study, four haptens were designed based on the common parent nucleus structure of the seven AQs combined with computer-aided simulation analysis. MD was used to analyze the recognition mechanism between AQ mAb-4D7 and the seven AQs, revealing that key amino acid residues (TRP90, ASP99, and TYR31) in the complementarity-determining region of the antibody maintain broad-spectrum recognition of AQs through the combined effects of Pi-Pi stacking, hydrogen bonding, and hydrophobic interactions. Based on AQ mAb-4D7, gold nanoparticles based on lateral flow immunoassay (GNP-LFIA) was developed for detecting the seven AQs in tea, aloe vera, and herbal drinks, with calculated limits of detection of 7.282-34.112 μg/kg, 5.536-27.338 μg/kg, and 5.025-26.319 μg/kg, respectively. In real sample detection, the method exhibited high consistency with the results of liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry confirming the accuracy and stability of GNP-LFIA and providing a reliable technical tool for the on-site rapid screening of multiple AQs in plant-derived foods.
