41996200.title_zh: 天然自上而下质谱法与曲妥珠单抗原研药和生物仿制药的高分辨率电荷变体分析相结合。
41996200.abstract_zh:
单克隆抗体 (mAb) 电荷异质性的全面表征对于确保产品质量、保持批次一致性和支持生物仿制药开发至关重要。电荷变体分析 (CVA) 广泛用于从主要物种中分离酸性和碱性蛋白质形式。然而，阳离子交换色谱法与质谱联用提供的信息有限，并且无法定位导致 mAb 异质性的翻译后修饰 (PTM)。在此，介绍了 pH 梯度 CVA 与天然自上而下质谱 (TD-MS) 的耦合，用于曲妥珠单抗的蛋白质形式特异性分析。在自然条件下对各个电荷变体进行色谱分离，并使用高能碰撞解离 (HCD)、电子转移解离 (ETD) 和紫外光解离 (UVPD) 在色谱时间尺度上直接裂解。质子转移电荷减少 (PTCR) 的添加有助于减少光谱拥塞并增强对高质量碎片离子的检测，从而提高序列覆盖率。
该工作流程能够对互补决定区 (CDR) 3 进行完整测序，并在完整蛋白质水平上直接识别和了解关键 PTM 的位置，包括单个蛋白质形式的脱酰胺、琥珀酰亚胺和 N 末端 PyroGlu。五个曲妥珠单抗样品（原研药和生物仿制药）的比较证明了片段模式、序列覆盖和变异分配的高重现性，凸显了该方法的稳健性。尽管由于在天然条件下破碎完整 mAb 的挑战仍然存在局限性，但这项工作为 mAb 的 CVA 天然 TD-MS 表征建立了概念验证，以补充自下而上和自中而下的分析，并且具有广泛适用于基于抗体的生物制药的潜力。

41975635.title: Rational Hapten Engineering Enables a Monoclonal Antibody for the Masked-Mycotoxin Zearalenone-14-Glucoside and Field-Deployable Digital Immunoassays.
41975635.abstract: Masked mycotoxins pose a persistent analytical challenge because their conjugated moieties are often weakly immunogenic and poorly captured by antibodies raised against parent toxins, leading to inadequate selectivity in rapid assays. Here, we introduce a computation-guided hapten engineering strategy for selectivity-by-design toward a masked toxin epitope, integrating conformational alignment, electrostatic potential mapping, and electronic structure descriptors to prioritize epitope presentation during immunization. Using zearalenone-14-glucoside (ZEN-14G) as a model analyte, this workflow enabled the generation of mAb-1C1, a monoclonal antibody elicited directly against a masked mycotoxin. The antibody exhibits sub-ng mL-1 competitive performance (IC50 = 0.093 ng mL-1) and a cross-reactivity profile consistent with masked-epitope preference. Docking and alanine-scanning mutagenesis establish a dual-interaction architecture in which hydrophobic contacts stabilize the conserved toxin core, while polar hotspot residues interact with the glucoside moiety, providing a mechanistic basis for selectivity. We further translate the recognition element into an indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), a rapid competitive lateral flow assay, and a smartphone-based quantitative readout that normalizes strip variability by using a C/T metric. Accuracy in multiple cereal matrices is validated against liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry/MS (LC-MS/MS). Collectively, this work demonstrates a generalizable selectivity engineering framework that links in silico hapten design, mechanistic paratope mapping, and deployable measurement formats for analytically elusive conjugated small molecules.
41975635.affiliation: National Key Laboratory of Agricultural Microbiology, National Reference Laboratory of Veterinary Drug Residues (HZAU) and MOA Key Laboratory for the Detection of Veterinary Drug Residues, College of Veterinary Medicine, Huazhong Agricultural University, Wuhan 430070, Hubei, People's Republic of China.
41975635.title_zh: Rational 半抗原工程为掩蔽霉菌毒素玉米赤霉烯酮 14-葡萄糖苷和可现场部署的数字免疫测定提供单克隆抗体。
41975635.abstract_zh:
隐蔽的霉菌毒素对分析提出了持续的挑战，因为它们的缀合部分通常具有弱免疫原性，并且很难被针对亲本毒素产生的抗体捕获，导致快速测定中选择性不足。在这里，我们引入了一种计算引导的半抗原工程策略，用于针对掩蔽的毒素表位进行设计选择性，集成构象对齐、静电势映射和电子结构描述符，以在免疫过程中优先考虑表位呈现。该工作流程使用玉米赤霉烯酮-14-葡萄糖苷 (ZEN-14G) 作为模型分析物，生成了 mAb-1C1，这是一种直接针对隐蔽霉菌毒素的单克隆抗体。该抗体表现出亚 ng mL-1 竞争性能 (IC50 = 0.093 ng mL-1) 和与掩蔽表位偏好一致的交叉反应特性。对接和丙氨酸扫描诱变建立了双重相互作用结构，其中疏水接触稳定了保守的毒素核心，而极性热点残基与糖苷部分相互作用，为选择性提供了机制基础。
我们进一步将识别元件转化为间接竞争性酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA)、快速竞争性侧流测定以及基于智能手机的定量读数，通过使用 C/T 指标来标准化条带变异性。通过液相色谱-质谱/MS (LC-MS/MS) 验证了多种谷物基质的准确性。总的来说，这项工作展示了一个可推广的选择性工程框架，该框架将计算机半抗原设计、机械互补位图谱和可部署的测量格式联系起来，用于分析难以捉摸的共轭小分子。

41936564.title: Two-Stage Purification of Recombinant Antibodies Using Non-Ionic Detergent Prevents Endotoxin-Induced Macrophage Activation: The Case of Bispecific Mini-Antibody MYSTI-2.
41936564.abstract: Escherichia coli is one of the most common producers of recombinant proteins, including therapeutic antibody fragments. However, the outer membrane of E. coli contains high levels of lipopolysaccharide (LPS, also known as endotoxin), which can activate innate immune receptors, trigger immune responses, and induce systemic inflammation that may progress to septic shock. Ensuring extremely low endotoxin levels in preparations intended for in vivo applications is critically important. In this study, we investigated the endotoxin content in preparations of the bispecific mini-antibody MYSTI-2 produced in two E. coli strains: the Rosetta strain, which synthesizes conventional LPS, and the ClearColi strain, which synthesizes potentially non-toxic form of LPS. Our results demonstrate that near-complete removal of LPS can be achieved only through the use of a non-ionic detergent during purification, regardless of the bacterial strain used for protein production.
41936564.affiliation: Laboratory of Molecular Mechanisms of Immunity, Engelhardt Institute of Molecular Biology, Russian Academy of Sciences, Moscow, 119991, Russia.
41936564.title_zh: 使用非离子洗涤剂对重组抗体进行两阶段纯化可防止内毒素诱导的巨噬细胞激活：双特异性微型抗体 MYSTI-2 的案例。
41936564.abstract_zh: 大肠杆菌是重组蛋白（包括治疗性抗体片段）最常见的生产者之一。然而，大肠杆菌的外膜含有高水平的脂多糖（LPS，也称为内毒素），它可以激活先天免疫受体，触发免疫反应，并诱发可能进展为感染性休克的全身炎症。确保用于体内应用的制剂中内毒素水平极低至关重要。在本研究中，我们研究了两种大肠杆菌菌株产生的双特异性微型抗体 MYSTI-2 制剂中的内毒素含量：Rosetta 菌株（合成常规 LPS）和 ClearColi 菌株（合成潜在无毒形式的 LPS）。我们的结果表明，无论用于蛋白质生产的细菌菌株如何，只有在纯化过程中使用非离子去污剂才能几乎完全去除脂多糖。

41905654.title: Aggregation of monoclonal and bispecific antibodies during pneumatic tube transport of IV bags in a hospital: Mitigation by polysorbate 80, poloxamer 188, and headspace removal.
41905654.abstract: Pneumatic tube systems (PTS) are being increasingly used in hospitals to rapidly transport critical packages, but their mechanical stresses raise concerns for the safe transport of protein therapeutics. This study examined the impact of the PTS at the University of Iowa Hospital on protein admixtures of a monoclonal antibody (mAb) and a bispecific antibody (BsAb) prepared in IV-bags and benchmarked it against manual transport and shaking. The PTS ride imposed sharp shocks nearly tenfold higher than either shaking or manual transport. Flow imaging microscopy revealed increased microparticle formation for both proteins, though with distinct profiles. The mAb generated more small aggregates, whereas the BsAb produced fewer yet larger particles. Surfactants reduced particle formation, with Polysorbate 80 (PS80) more effective than poloxamer 188. For BsAb, PS80 lowered microparticles by ∼70% but failed to prevent large particle formation, in contrast to its near-complete protection for mAb. Headspace removal further reduced particle formation, fully preventing the formation of large aggregates when combined with PS80. Size exclusion chromatography revealed no detectable increase in soluble aggregates or monomer loss. These findings show that PTS presents a unique stress profile not replicated by shaking and highlight the need for case-by-case evaluation of PTS compatibility based on protein, container, and excipients.
41905654.affiliation: Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Experimental Therapeutics, College of Pharmacy, University of Iowa, Iowa City, USA; Center for Biocatalysis and Bioprocessing, University of Iowa, Coralville, USA.
41905654.title_zh: 医院内静脉输液袋气动管运输过程中单克隆和双特异性抗体的聚集：通过聚山梨醇酯 80、泊洛沙姆 188 和顶空去除来缓解。
41905654.abstract_zh:
气动管道系统 (PTS) 越来越多地在医院中用于快速运输关键包裹，但其机械应力引发了人们对蛋白质治疗药物安全运输的担忧。本研究考察了爱荷华大学医院的 PTS 对静脉注射袋中制备的单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和双特异性抗体 (BsAb) 的蛋白质混合物的影响，并针对手动运输和摇动对其进行了基准测试。 PTS 行驶产生的剧烈震动比摇晃或手动运输高出近十倍。流式成像显微镜显示两种蛋白质的微粒形成增加，尽管具有不同的特征。 mAb 产生更多的小聚集体，而 BsAb 产生更少但更大的颗粒。表面活性剂减少了颗粒形成，其中聚山梨醇酯 80 (PS80) 比泊洛沙姆 188 更有效。对于 BsAb，PS80 使微粒减少约 70%，但未能阻止大颗粒形成，这与它对 mAb 近乎完全的保护形成鲜明对比。顶空去除进一步减少了颗粒形成，与 PS80 结合时完全防止了大聚集体的形成。
尺寸排阻色谱显示没有可检测到的可溶性聚集体增加或单体损失。这些发现表明，PTS 呈现出一种独特的应力分布，无法通过摇动来复制，并强调需要根据蛋白质、容器和赋形剂对 PTS 兼容性进行逐案评估。

42568918.title: Anti-inflammatory effect of novel polypeptide WMX-8 through specific blockade of the IL17RA signaling pathway.
42568918.abstract: Interleukin-17 receptor A (IL17RA) acts as a core mediator of pro-inflammatory signaling and contributes crucially to the pathogenesis of autoimmune disorders including psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. Monoclonal antibodies against IL17RA have achieved clinical application, yet their clinical utility is restricted by multiple drawbacks: high production cost, complicated manufacturing procedures, mandatory injection delivery, and absent oral bioavailability. To overcome these bottlenecks, this study develops a novel inhibitory peptide WMX-8 intended to specifically disrupt the binding between IL17A and IL17RA. The polypeptide WMX-8 was rationally designed and chemically synthesized, followed by purification to obtain high-purity samples. A series of systematic in vitro biological assessments were conducted using IL17RA-expressing cell models (keratinocytes and monocyte-macrophages), alongside IL17RA-deficient cells as negative control groups. Biochemical and cellular assays verified that WMX-8 binds IL17RA with strong affinity and markedly suppresses the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines in IL17RA-positive keratinocytes and monocyte-macrophages. Its anti-inflammatory efficacy is equivalent to that of the reference anti-IL17RA monoclonal antibody. The inhibitory activity fully relies on IL17RA expression, since the anti-inflammatory effect disappears entirely in IL17RA-knockout cells. In addition, WMX-8 displays desirable pharmaceutical features, including low immunogenicity and convenient large-scale synthesis.This study validates the promising druggable properties of WMX-8 targeting the IL17A-IL17RA axis. Our findings lay a solid foundation for further preclinical investigation of peptide therapeutics against IL17A/IL17RA for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
42568918.affiliation: School of Life Science and Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Science and Technology, Baotou, China.
42568918.title_zh: 新型多肽 WMX-8 通过特异性阻断 IL17RA 信号通路发挥抗炎作用。
42568918.abstract_zh:
白细胞介素 17 受体 A (IL17RA) 作为促炎信号传导的核心介质，在银屑病和类风湿性关节炎等自身免疫性疾病的发病机制中发挥着至关重要的作用。 IL17RA单克隆抗体已实现临床应用，但其临床应用受到生产成本高、生产流程复杂、必须注射给药、缺乏口服生物利用度等诸多缺点的限制。为了克服这些瓶颈，本研究开发了一种新型抑制肽 WMX-8，旨在特异性破坏 IL17A 和 IL17RA 之间的结合。多肽WMX-8经过合理设计和化学合成，经过纯化得到高纯度样品。使用表达 IL17RA 的细胞模型（角质形成细胞和单核巨噬细胞）以及作为阴性对照组的 IL17RA 缺陷细胞进行了一系列系统的体外生物学评估。生化和细胞测定证实，WMX-8 以强亲和力结合 IL17RA，并显着抑制 IL17RA 阳性角质形成细胞和单核巨噬细胞中促炎细胞因子的分泌。
其抗炎功效与参考抗IL17RA单克隆抗体相当。抑制活性完全依赖于 IL17RA 的表达，因为在 IL17RA 敲除细胞中抗炎作用完全消失。此外，WMX-8 显示出理想的药物特性，包括低免疫原性和方便的大规模合成。这项研究验证了 WMX-8 靶向 IL17A-IL17RA 轴的有前途的成药特性。我们的研究结果为进一步针对IL17A/IL17RA的肽疗法治疗自身免疫性疾病的临床前研究奠定了坚实的基础。

42554770.title: Identification and computational analysis of B-cell epitopes on the hemagglutinin protein of the H3N2 influenza virus.
42554770.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) is a highly infectious enveloped RNA virus that primarily causes respiratory disease. Continuous antigenic variation in influenza virus hemagglutinin (HA) is a major driver of influenza pandemics. Therefore, precise identification of B-cell epitopes within HA is essential for developing diagnostic tools and vaccine candidates that can help limit further influenza spread. In the present study, an integrated experimental and bioinformatics strategy was used. A trimeric HA protein was rationally designed to improve antigenicity and immunogenicity, expressed in a mammalian eukaryotic expression system, and purified by Ni-affinity chromatography. After animal immunization, nine HA-specific monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), namely 5D5, 6B8, 9E7, 13F8, 14C3, 15F6, 16B5, 17H7, and 20C5, were generated. These mAbs specifically recognized HA protein in western blotting and indirect immunofluorescence assays (IFA). B-cell epitopes on HA were subsequently mapped using these mAbs by indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), dot-blot, western blotting, and IFA. Six previously unreported linear B-cell epitopes were identified: 21GNDNSTATL29, 41IVKTITNDR49, 116YDVPDYASL124, 382DLKSTQAAI390, 458SEMNKLFEK466, and 488KCDNACIGS496. Bioinformatics analysis further revealed the spatial distribution and structural characteristics of these epitope regions on HA. These findings expand the current understanding of HA epitopes and provide a theoretical basis for developing IAV subunit vaccines and highly sensitive detection methods.
42554770.affiliation: Longhu Laboratory of Advanced Immunology, No. 218, Ping AN Avenue, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, 450046, Henan, People's Republic of China.
42554770.title_zh: H3N2 流感病毒血凝素蛋白上 B 细胞表位的鉴定和计算分析。
42554770.abstract_zh:
甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 是一种传染性极强的有包膜 RNA 病毒，主要引起呼吸道疾病。流感病毒血凝素（HA）的持续抗原变异是流感大流行的主要驱动因素。因此，精确鉴定 HA 内的 B 细胞表位对于开发有助于限制流感进一步传播的诊断工具和候选疫苗至关重要。在本研究中，采用了综合实验和生物信息学策略。合理设计三聚体HA蛋白，提高抗原性和免疫原性，在哺乳动物真核表达系统中表达，并通过Ni亲和层析纯化。动物免疫后，产生了九种HA特异性单克隆抗体（mAb），即5D5、6B8、9E7、13F8、14C3、15F6、16B5、17H7和20C5。这些 mAb 在蛋白质印迹和间接免疫荧光测定 (IFA) 中特异性识别 HA 蛋白。随后使用这些 mAb 通过间接酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA)、斑点印迹、蛋白质印迹和 IFA 绘制 HA 上的 B 细胞表位。
鉴定了 6 个先前未报告的线性 B 细胞表位：21GNDNSTATL29、41IVKTITNDR49、116YDVPDYASL124、382DLKSTQAAI390、458SEMNKLFEK466 和 488KCDNACIGS496。生物信息学分析进一步揭示了HA上这些表位区域的空间分布和结构特征。这些发现拓展了目前对HA表位的认识，为开发IAV亚单位疫苗和高灵敏检测方法提供了理论基础。

42487284.title: Development of a 177Lu-Labeled Glypican-3-Targeted Antibody Radiopharmaceutical for Adjuvant Radionuclide Therapy Following Hepatocellular Carcinoma Resection.
42487284.abstract: Background: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains the major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide due to high postoperative recurrence rates and limited treatment options for minimal residual disease (MRD).Methods: In this study, glypican-3 (GPC3)-targeted radiopharmaceutical, 177Lu-DOTA-GPC3, was developed and evaluated as a potential adjuvant targeted radionuclide therapy for HCC. The anti-GPC3 monoclonal antibody was conjugated with DOTA and radiolabeled with 177Lu under systematically optimized conditions. Optimization of the chelator-to-antibody ratio, pH, temperature, and incubation time was performed to maximize the radiochemical yield while preserving antibody immunoreactivity and structural integrity. The radioconjugate was purified and characterized using instant thin-layer chromatography and size-exclusion high-performance liquid chromatography. In vitro stability was assessed in phosphate-buffered saline and human serum, while cellular binding and internalization studies were conducted using GPC3-expressing HepG2 cells. In vivo biodistribution, pharmacokinetics, and therapeutic efficacy were evaluated in the tumor-bearing mice.Results: The developed radioconjugate demonstrated high radiolabeling efficiency (96.8% ± 1.2%) and radiochemical purity (>98%) with excellent stability (>95% up to 72 h). Batch-to-batch reproducibility showed minimal variability across independent preparations. Strong receptor-specific cellular binding (∼82%) and significant internalization were observed, confirming preservation of the biological activity following radiolabeling. Biodistribution studies demonstrated high tumor uptake (18.6% ± 2.1%ID/g at 48 h) with favorable tumor-to-background ratios. Therapeutic evaluation revealed up to 66.4% tumor growth inhibition and significantly prolonged survival without observable systemic toxicity.Conclusions: Findings support the potential of the 177Lu-DOTA-GPC3 as a promising theranostic radionuclide platform for targeting GPC3-positive HCC and addressing postoperative MRD-associated recurrence.
42487284.affiliation: Department of General Surgery III, Hubei Wuxue Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, Huanggang, China.
42487284.title_zh: 开发 177Lu 标记的磷脂酰肌醇蛋白聚糖 3 靶向抗体放射性药物，用于肝细胞癌切除术后的辅助放射性核素治疗。
42487284.abstract_zh:
背景：由于术后复发率高和微小残留病（MRD）治疗选择有限，肝细胞癌（HCC）仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。方法：在这项研究中，开发并评估了磷脂酰肌醇蛋白聚糖-3（GPC3）靶向放射性药物 177Lu-DOTA-GPC3，并评估其作为 HCC 潜在辅助靶向放射性核素治疗的作用。抗GPC3单克隆抗体与DOTA缀合，并在系统优化的条件下用177Lu进行放射性标记。对螯合剂与抗体的比例、pH、温度和孵育时间进行优化，以最大限度地提高放射化学产量，同时保留抗体的免疫反应性和结构完整性。使用即时薄层色谱和尺寸排阻高效液相色谱对放射性结合物进行纯化和表征。在磷酸盐缓冲盐水和人血清中评估体外稳定性，同时使用表达 GPC3 的 HepG2 细胞进行细胞结合和内化研究。
在荷瘤小鼠中评估了体内生物分布、药代动力学和治疗效果。结果：所开发的放射性结合物表现出高放射性标记效率（96.8％±1.2％）和放射化学纯度（> 98％）以及出色的稳定性（> 95％长达72小时）。批次间的重现性显示独立制剂之间的差异最小。观察到强的受体特异性细胞结合（~82%）和显着的内化，证实放射性标记后生物活性的保留。生物分布研究表明肿瘤摄取较高（48 小时时为 18.6% ± 2.1%ID/g），且具有良好的肿瘤背景比。治疗评估显示，肿瘤生长抑制高达 66.4%，显着延长生存期，且未观察到全身毒性。结论：研究结果支持 177Lu-DOTA-GPC3 作为一种有前途的治疗诊断放射性核素平台的潜力，用于靶向 GPC3 阳性 HCC 并解决术后 MRD 相关复发。

42458707.title: Screening of bispecific antibodies during single cell cloning of recombinant Chinese hamster ovary cell lines to improve titer and product quality.
42458707.abstract: Development of therapeutic bispecific antibodies (BsAbs) poses significant manufacturability challenges associated with correct chain pairing and an increased diversity of impurities. Here we address this with a product quality assessment during cell line development (CLD), forgoing the need for genetic characterization during cell line screening. Using Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cell lines expressing a panel of monoclonal antibodies (mAb) and BsAbs, we demonstrate the highly specific binding of SpotLight™ Huλ, Huĸ and HuFc reagents to their target chain isotypes (lambda or kappa light chain and Fc regions) during single cell cloning workflows on a Bruker Beacon® Optofluidic System. We then demonstrate combinatorial use of SpotLight™ Huλ and Huĸ reagents as an early product quality indicator on a CHO cell line expressing a BsAb with dual kappa-lambda light chain configuration. Cell lines presenting equal binding profiles for each SpotLight assay exhibited platform-typical heterodimer levels with an average of 87.26% following fed-batch bioreactor production assessment. Conversely, cell lines biased towards either SpotLight™ assay resulted in lower than desired heterodimer (0%-84.23%) and increased associated impurities. This study demonstrates the application of dual SpotLight™ assays as an identifier of CHO cell lines expressing a kappa-lambda light chain BsAb with a high heterodimer percentage. This allows cell lines with optimal product quality to be identified earlier in CLD, resulting in fewer cell lines being progressed to resource-intensive fed-batch studies and subsequent product quality assessment. Furthermore, this assay provides an opportunity to characterize impurity expression biases prior to developing downstream purification processes.
42458707.affiliation: BioPharm Process Research, Drug Substance Development, GSK, Stevenage, UK.
42458707.title_zh: 在重组中国仓鼠卵巢细胞系的单细胞克隆过程中筛选双特异性抗体，以提高效价和产品质量。
42458707.abstract_zh:
治疗性双特异性抗体 (BsAb) 的开发带来了与正确的链配对和增加的杂质多样性相关的重大可制造性挑战。在这里，我们通过细胞系开发 (CLD) 过程中的产品质量评估来解决这个问题，而无需在细胞系筛选过程中进行遗传表征。使用表达一组单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和 BsAb 的中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞系，我们在 Bruker Beacon® 光流控系统上的单细胞克隆工作流程中证明了 SpotLight™ Huλ、Huĸ 和 HuFc 试剂与其靶链同种型（lambda 或 kappa 轻链和 Fc 区）的高度特异性结合。然后，我们展示了 SpotLight™ Huλ 和 Huĸ 试剂的组合使用，作为表达具有双 kappa-lambda 轻链配置的 BsAb 的 CHO 细胞系的早期产品质量指标。在每次 SpotLight 测定中呈现相同结合谱的细胞系表现出平台典型的异二聚体水平，在补料分批生物反应器生产评估后平均为 87.26%。
相反，偏向于 SpotLight™ 检测的细胞系会导致异二聚体低于预期 (0%-84.23%) 并增加相关杂质。本研究展示了双 SpotLight™ 测定法作为表达具有高异二聚体百分比的 kappa-lambda 轻链 BsAb 的 CHO 细胞系的标识符的应用。这使得在 CLD 中能够更早地鉴定出具有最佳产品质量的细胞系，从而减少进入资源密集型补料分批研究和随后的产品质量评估的细胞系。此外，该测定提供了在开发下游纯化工艺之前表征杂质表达偏差的机会。

42449784.title: Development of a Double-Antibody Sandwich ELISA for the Detection of HPV16 E6 Protein.
42449784.abstract: Background: The HPV16 E6 oncoprotein facilitates the ubiquitin-mediated degradation of the tumor suppressor p53, constituting a pivotal mechanism underlying viral immune evasion, cellular immortalization, and ultimately, malignant transformation. This study aimed to develop a reliable detection tool for the HPV16 E6 protein. Methods: Recombinant GST-E6 and E6-His proteins were expressed and purified using a prokaryotic expression system. Female BALB/c mice were immunized with GST-E6, and two hybridoma cell lines (G11A11 and A4) stably secreting anti-HPV16 E6 monoclonal antibodies were generated via hybridoma technology. Antibody pairing experiments identified A4 and G11A11 as suitable for sandwich ELISA. The optimal detection system was established using A4 antibody at 2 μg/mL for coating, HPV16 E6-His at 5 μg/mL as the detection antigen, and G11A11-HRP at a 1:200 dilution as the detection antibody. To validate the reliability, Hacat-HPV16E6 cell lysates were tested in parallel with a commercial ELISA kit. Results: After purification, the titers of both antibodies reached 1:204,800. The lower limit of quantification (LOQ) was 4.79 ng/mL and the limit of detection (LOD) was 3.39 ng/mL. The comparison with the commercial kit showed good consistency, with percentage differences ranging from 20% to 40%, confirming that the established ELISA is reliable for quantitative detection. Conclusions: This study successfully yielded high-titer and highly specific anti-HPV16 E6 monoclonal antibodies and developed a specific double-antibody sandwich ELISA, thereby furnishing a technical foundation for both fundamental research and laboratory-based applications related to HPV16-associated tumors.
42449784.affiliation: Longhu Laboratory of Advanced Immunology, Zhengzhou 450046, China.
42449784.title_zh: 开发用于检测 HPV16 E6 蛋白的双抗体夹心 ELISA。
42449784.abstract_zh:
背景：HPV16 E6癌蛋白促进泛素介导的抑癌基因p53降解，构成病毒免疫逃避、细胞永生化和最终恶性转化的关键机制。本研究旨在开发一种可靠的 HPV16 E6 蛋白检测工具。方法：利用原核表达系统表达并纯化重组GST-E6和E6-His蛋白。用GST-E6免疫雌性BALB/c小鼠，通过杂交瘤技术产生稳定分泌抗HPV16 E6单克隆抗体的两种杂交瘤细胞系（G11A11和A4）。抗体配对实验确定 A4 和 G11A11 适合夹心 ELISA。以2 μg/mL A4抗体包被、5 μg/mL HPV16 E6-His为检测抗原、1:200稀释的G11A11-HRP为检测抗体建立了最佳检测体系。为了验证可靠性，Hacat-HPV16E6 细胞裂解物与商业 ELISA 试剂盒同时进行了测试。结果：纯化后，两种抗体效价均达到1:204,800。
定量下限 (LOQ) 为 4.79 ng/mL，检测限 (LOD) 为 3.39 ng/mL。与市售试剂盒的比较显示出良好的一致性，百分比差异在20%至40%之间，证实所建立的ELISA用于定量检测是可靠的。结论：本研究成功获得了高滴度、高特异性的抗HPV16 E6单克隆抗体，并开发了特异性双抗体夹心ELISA，为HPV16相关肿瘤的基础研究和实验室应用奠定了技术基础。

42285912.title: Comparison of knockdown approaches for the generation of stable cell populations expressing afucosylated antibodies.
42285912.abstract: Targeted silencing of cellular genes in cell lines stably expressing a secreted recombinant protein offers a flexible and convenient strategy for modulating product quality attributes. However, unlike genetic knockout of a cellular gene or the use of potent inhibitors to eliminate cellular enzyme activity, gene knockdown approaches using microRNAs (miRNA) or short hairpin RNAs (shRNA) may result in only partial reduction of enzyme activity and only partial change of the desired product quality attribute. Moreover, through saturation of the Dicer pathway, shRNA may introduce cytotoxic effects that affect product yield. In this study, we demonstrate that miRNAs are a more suitable tool than shRNAs for α1,6-fucosyltransferase (FUT8) knockdown in Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells, when expressed under the control of an RNA-Polymerase II promoter. In the presence of miRNAs targeted to the FUT8 mRNA, the fucosylation levels of the N-glycan linked to Asn297 (EU numbering) of a recombinant monoclonal antibody (mAb) were considerably reduced (>90% afucosylation by hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography - high‑performance liquid chromatography; no detectable fucosylated product by intact mass spectrometry), without a relevant impact on mAb expression. By comparison, overexpression of shRNAs targeted to the FUT8 mRNA resulted in higher levels of residual fucosylation of the mAb and a larger reduction in mAb titers. miRNAs overcame a limitation of the knockdown approach with shRNAs, making this approach a valuable tool for biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
42285912.affiliation: Drug Substance Development, IGI Therapeutics SA, La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland.
42285912.title_zh: 比较用于产生表达无岩藻糖基化抗体的稳定细胞群的敲低方法。
42285912.abstract_zh:
稳定表达分泌重组蛋白的细胞系中细胞基因的靶向沉默为调节产品质量属性提供了灵活且方便的策略。然而，与细胞基因的基因敲除或使用强效抑制剂消除细胞酶活性不同，使用 microRNA (miRNA) 或短发夹 RNA (shRNA) 的基因敲除方法可能会导致酶活性仅部分降低，并且所需产品质量属性仅部分改变。此外，通过 Dicer 途径的饱和，shRNA 可能会引入影响产物产量的细胞毒性作用。在这项研究中，我们证明，当在 RNA 聚合酶 II 启动子的控制下表达时，miRNA 是比 shRNA 更适合敲低中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞中 α1,6-岩藻糖基转移酶 (FUT8) 的工具。在存在针对 FUT8 mRNA 的 miRNA 的情况下，与重组单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的 Asn297（EU 编号）相连的 N-聚糖的岩藻糖基化水平显着降低（通过亲水相互作用液相色谱 - 高效液相色谱检测，无岩藻糖基化>90%；
通过完整质谱法未检测到岩藻糖基化产物），对 mAb 表达没有相关影响。相比之下，针对 FUT8 mRNA 的 shRNA 的过度表达导致 mAb 的残余岩藻糖基化水平更高，并且 mAb 滴度大幅降低。 miRNA 克服了 shRNA 击倒方法的局限性，使该方法成为生物制药制造的宝贵工具。

42276533.title: Comparative analysis of charge heterogeneity in anti-sclerostin monoclonal antibodies produced via continuous perfusion and fed-batch processes.
42276533.abstract: As critical quality attributes, post-translational modifications (PTMs) of therapeutic monoclonal antibodies in production impact their structural stability, charge heterogeneity, and clinical efficacy. This study elucidated PTM-driven charge isomer disparities in anti-sclerostin monoclonal antibodies from continuous perfusion versus fed-batch bioreactor processes. By developing an integrated analytical platform combining strong cation-exchange chromatography, size-exclusion chromatography, and non-reducing capillary electrophoresis with high-resolution mass spectrometry, we precisely characterized molecular weight variations and signature PTM profiles across distinct charge isomers. The study revealed that basic isomer 1 predominantly originated from C-terminal glycine loss and methionine oxidation, while basic isomer 2 arose from incomplete N-terminal glutamine cyclization and N-terminal truncation. The fed-batch process uniquely induced degradation at the heavy chain Met250-Ile251 site and significantly elevated low-molecular-weight species content. Crucially, antibodies from both processes exhibited minimal differences in purity and PTM profiles, robustly validating the feasibility of process transition. Biological activity assessment results showed that the relative binding activities of charge isomers from both processes ranged between 90 and 121%. The equilibrium dissociation constant values for binding to the neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor were all within (5∼9) × 10-1 μM, indicating that FcRn function was unaffected by charge heterogeneity or the process. In summary, this study systematically compares the impact of two production processes-fed-batch and continuous perfusion-on the charge heterogeneity and biological activity of an anti-sclerostin monoclonal antibody. This work not only identifies key quality benchmarks for antibody process optimization but also establishes a PTM fingerprint-based standard for evaluating process comparability, providing critical guidance for advancing continuous biomanufacturing technologies.
42276533.affiliation: College of Pharmaceutical Science, Zhejiang University of Technology, Hangzhou, 310014, China. Electronic address: yiyu1106@zjut.edu.cn.
42276533.title_zh: 通过连续灌注和补料分批工艺产生的抗硬化素单克隆抗体中电荷异质性的比较分析。
42276533.abstract_zh:
作为关键的质量属性，治疗性单克隆抗体在生产过程中的翻译后修饰 (PTM) 会影响其结构稳定性、电荷异质性和临床疗效。这项研究阐明了连续灌注与分批补料生物反应器过程中抗硬化素单克隆抗体中 PTM 驱动的电荷异构体差异。通过开发一个将强阳离子交换色谱、尺寸排阻色谱、非还原毛细管电泳与高分辨率质谱相结合的集成分析平台，我们精确地表征了不同电荷异构体的分子量变化和特征性 PTM 谱。研究表明，碱性异构体1主要源于C端甘氨酸丢失和蛋氨酸氧化，而碱性异构体2则源于N端谷氨酰胺环化不完全和N端截断。补料分批工艺独特地诱导了重链 Met250-Ile251 位点的降解，并显着提高了低分子量物质的含量。
至关重要的是，两种工艺的抗体在纯度和 PTM 图谱上表现出最小的差异，有力地验证了工艺转换的可行性。生物活性评估结果表明，两个过程中电荷异构体的相对结合活性在 90% 至 121% 之间。与新生儿片段可结晶受体结合的平衡解离常数值均在(5∼9)×10-1μM范围内，表明FcRn功能不受电荷异质性或过程的影响。总之，本研究系统地比较了两种生产工艺（分批补料和连续灌注）对抗硬化素单克隆抗体的电荷异质性和生物活性的影响。这项工作不仅确定了抗体工艺优化的关键质量基准，还建立了基于 PTM 指纹的标准来评估工艺可比性，为推进连续生物制造技术提供了关键指导。

42272446.title: Advances in the use of DNA aptamers for bioanalysis of antibody-based therapeutics.
42272446.abstract: Nucleic acid aptamers are single-stranded oligonucleotides that fold into defined three-dimensional structures and bind molecular targets with high affinity and specificity. Because aptamers are sequence-defined, chemically synthesized reagents, they offer high purity, minimal lot-to-lot variability, and flexible functionalization, positioning them as practical alternatives or complements to antibody-based critical reagents in regulated bioanalysis. This review summarizes the current landscape of DNA aptamer-enabled bioanalysis for therapeutic monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), with emphasis on three application areas: (i) ELISA-compatible ligand-binding assays, (ii) immunocapture workflows coupled to liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry or LC-based measurements, and (iii) aptamer-based biosensors for bioanalysis and process analytics. This review highlights key considerations in aptamer acquisition (SELEX design, partitioning, and counter-selection to improve anti-idiotype selectivity) and illustrates representative assay configurations, including drug-to-antibody ratio-responsive formats for ADCs and ratiometric/electrochemical and fluorescence resonance energy transfer-based aptasensors for on-site monitoring. Finally, this review discusses future directions, notably coupling aptamer binding to nucleic acid amplification for ultra-sensitive quantification, and practical challenges, such as nuclease susceptibility, nonspecific interactions with serum proteins, and structure-dependent robustness that must be addressed under fit-for-purpose validation frameworks.
42272446.affiliation: Laboratory of Analytical and Bio-Analytical Chemistry, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, University of Shizuoka, Shizuoka, Japan.
42272446.title_zh: 使用 DNA 适体进行抗体疗法生物分析的进展。
42272446.abstract_zh:
核酸适体是单链寡核苷酸，可折叠成确定的三维结构并以高亲和力和特异性结合分子靶标。由于适体是序列定义的化学合成试剂，因此它们具有高纯度、最小批次变异性和灵活的功能化，使其成为受监管生物分析中基于抗体的关键试剂的实用替代品或补充。本综述总结了目前用于治疗性单克隆抗体 (mAb) 和抗体药物偶联物 (ADC) 的 DNA 适体生物分析的前景，重点关注三个应用领域：(i) ELISA 兼容的配体结合测定，(ii) 与液相色谱-串联质谱或基于 LC 的测量相结合的免疫捕获工作流程，以及 (iii) 用于生物分析和过程分析的基于适体的生物传感器。
本综述重点介绍了适体采集中的关键考虑因素（SELEX 设计、分区和反选择以提高抗独特型选择性），并说明了代表性的测定配置，包括 ADC 的药物与抗体比率响应格式以及用于现场监测的基于比率/电化学和荧光共振能量转移的适体传感器。最后，这篇综述讨论了未来的方向，特别是将适配体结合到核酸扩增上以实现超灵敏定量，以及实际挑战，例如核酸酶敏感性、与血清蛋白的非特异性相互作用以及必须在适合目的的验证框架下解决的结构依赖性稳健性。

42217505.title: Development of trypsin peptide mapping for hydroxylysine modification quantification in an IgG4 bispecific antibody and investigation of influencing factors.
42217505.abstract: We report the first identification of a rare hydroxylysine modification in the heavy chain 2 (HC2) region of an IgG4 bispecific antibody using peptide mapping coupled with liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS). The modified peptide matches the XKG consensus sequence recognized by lysyl hydroxylases. This modification severely impaired trypsin digestion efficiency: approximately 81% of missed cleavage peptides at this site contained hydroxylysine, indicating a strong association between the modification and missed cleavage. To reduce missed cleavage and enable accurate quantification of hydroxylysine, we systematically optimized the digestion conditions (buffer composition, pH, incubation temperature, digestion time, enzyme to antibody ratio) to enhance trypsin efficiency. This optimized method was subsequently applied to investigate the factors contributing to hydroxylation variability during antibody manufacturing. Our results showed that the downstream purification processes and storage stability conditions did not influence the hydroxylation levels. In contrast, key upstream cell culture parameters distinctly modulated hydroxylation: both a lower post-shift temperature and an earlier shift time resulted in a greater reduction in the modification level, whereas prolonged culture duration caused only a mild decrease. This work presents an optimized trypsin peptide mapping method that overcomes hydroxylysine-induced missed cleavage, enabling reliable quantification of this rare modification. Furthermore, it provides critical insights into the process dependence of hydroxylysine formation, facilitating the development of improved quality control strategies for therapeutic antibody production.

42217505.title_zh: 开发用于 IgG4 双特异性抗体中羟赖氨酸修饰定量的胰蛋白酶肽图谱并研究影响因素。
42217505.abstract_zh:
我们报告了使用肽图谱结合液相色谱-质谱法 (LC-MS) 首次鉴定了 IgG4 双特异性抗体重链 2 (HC2) 区域中的罕见羟赖氨酸修饰。修饰后的肽与赖氨酰羟化酶识别的 XKG 共有序列相匹配。这种修饰严重损害了胰蛋白酶的消化效率：该位点大约 81% 的漏切肽含有羟赖氨酸，表明该修饰与漏切之间存在很强的关联。为了减少漏切并实现羟赖氨酸的准确定量，我们系统地优化了消化条件（缓冲液组成、pH、孵育温度、消化时间、酶与抗体的比例）以提高胰蛋白酶效率。随后应用这种优化方法来研究抗体制造过程中羟基化变异性的影响因素。我们的结果表明，下游纯化过程和储存稳定性条件不影响羟基化水平。
相比之下，关键的上游细胞培养参数明显调节羟基化：较低的转移后温度和较早的转移时间都会导致修饰水平的更大降低，而延长培养时间仅导致轻微的降低。这项工作提出了一种优化的胰蛋白酶肽图分析方法，该方法克服了羟赖氨酸诱导的漏切，从而能够对这种罕见的修饰进行可靠的定量。此外，它还提供了对羟赖氨酸形成过程依赖性的重要见解，有助于开发改进的治疗性抗体生产质量控制策略。

42145184.title: Computer-Aided Rational Hapten Design of Mepiquat Chloride: High-Affinity Antibody and Sensitive Immunoassay for Food and Environmental Samples.
42145184.abstract: Mepiquat chloride (MQ) residues threaten human health and ecological safety, requiring rapid and sensitive monitoring. In this study, five haptens were designed for poorly immunogenic MQ, and MQ-H4/MQ-H5 was identified as the optimal pair via computer-aided analysis and serum validation, generating MQ mAb-5H2 with high affinity and specificity. Based on this mAb, a gold nanoparticle-based lateral-flow immunochromatographic assay was developed for MQ on-site screening, with the calculated limits of detection of 0.034, 0.049, and 0.016 mg/kg in potato, wheat, and soil, respectively. The reliability and accuracy of the method were verified through spiked recovery experiments, showing recoveries from 95.2 to 105.7% and a coefficient of variation of 1.6-7.1%, consistent with the results of high-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry, providing a practical and reliable tool for MQ monitoring and a hapten-driven strategy for high-performance antibody generation and sensitive immunoassays targeting other quaternary ammonium pesticides.
42145184.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

42145184.title_zh: 缩节胺的计算机辅助合理半抗原设计：食品和环境样品的高亲和力抗体和灵敏免疫分析。
42145184.abstract_zh: 缩节胺 (MQ) 残留威胁人类健康和生态安全，需要快速、灵敏的监测。本研究针对免疫原性较差的 MQ 设计了 ​​5 种半抗原，通过计算机辅助分析和血清验证确定 MQ-H4/MQ-H5 为最佳配对，生成具有高亲和力和特异性的 MQ mAb-5H2。基于该单克隆抗体，开发了一种基于金纳米颗粒的侧流免疫层析法，用于 MQ 现场筛查，计算出马铃薯、小麦和土壤中的检出限分别为 0.034、0.049 和 0.016 mg/kg。通过加标回收实验验证了该方法的可靠性和准确度，回收率在95.2%~105.7%之间，变异系数在1.6%~7.1%之间，与高效液相色谱-质谱联用结果一致，为MQ监测提供了实用可靠的工具，为针对其他季铵农药的高性能抗体生成和灵敏免疫分析提供了半抗原驱动的策略。

42129093.title: Updates to Guidance on Using Biacore for Protein-Protein Interactions Analysis.
42129093.abstract: The use of optical biosensors for studying macromolecular interactions is now considered essential technology for understanding the biophysical properties of potential therapeutic and diagnostic reagents. Indeed, according to Cytiva (2025, Key-SPR-applications. https://www.cytivalifesciences.com/en/us/solutions/protein-research/Interaction-analysis-with-Biacore-surface-plasmon-resonance-SPR/Key-SPR-applications ), over 50 000 Biacore papers have been published to date, the sheer volume and variety of which present a daunting task for the burgeoning Biacore user to accumulate and decipher. This chapter is designed to provide the reader with the tools necessary to prepare, design, and efficiently execute a kinetic experiment on Biacore. This document is written to guide the Biacore user through basic theory, system maintenance, and assay setup, while also offering some practical tips that we find useful for Biacore-based studies. Many kinetic-based screening assays require rigorous sample preparation and purification prior to analysis. To highlight these procedures, this protocol describes the kinetic characterization of single-chain Fv (scFv) antibody fragments from crude bacterial lysates using an antibody affinity capture approach. Although we specifically describe the capture of HA-tagged scFv antibody fragments to an anti-HA tag monoclonal antibody-immobilized surface prior to kinetic analysis, these methodologies are universally applicable and can be used for practically any affinity pair and most Biacore systems.

42129093.title_zh: 使用 Biacore 进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析指南的更新。
42129093.abstract_zh:
使用光学生物传感器研究大分子相互作用现在被认为是了解潜在治疗和诊断试剂的生物物理特性的基本技术。事实上，根据 Cytiva（2025 年，Key-SPR-applications。https://www.cytivalifesciences.com/en/us/solutions/ Protein-research/Interaction-analysis-with-Biacore-surface-plasmon-resonance-SPR/Key-SPR-applications）的说法，迄今为止已发表了 50 000 多篇 Biacore 论文，其中的数量和种类对研究人员来说是一项艰巨的任务。不断增长的 Biacore 用户进行积累和解密。本章旨在为读者提供在 Biacore 上准备、设计和高效执行动力学实验所需的工具。本文档旨在指导 Biacore 用户了解基本理论、系统维护和测定设置，同时还提供一些我们认为对基于 Biacore 的研究有用的实用技巧。许多基于动力学的筛选测定在分析前需要严格的样品制备和纯化。
为了强调这些程序，该协议描述了使用抗体亲和捕获方法从粗细菌裂解物中获得的单链 Fv (scFv) 抗体片段的动力学表征。尽管我们具体描述了在动力学分析之前将 HA 标记的 scFv 抗体片段捕获到抗 HA 标记单克隆抗体固定的表面，但这些方法是普遍适用的，并且可用于几乎任何亲和对和大多数 Biacore 系统。

42093402.title: Unveiling the geographical signature of black tea through UHPLC-quadrupole-Orbitrap Exploris HRMS analysis.
42093402.abstract: Understanding the geographical differentiation of black tea is essential for exploring the influence of territory on its chemical composition. In this study, black tea (powder) samples from key tea-producing regions, including Siliguri, Assam, and Idukki (Kerala) in India, Sylhet in Bangladesh, and Kandy in Sri Lanka, were analyzed using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with high-resolution mass spectrometry. The tea extracts were analysed in full MS/ddMS2 mode with heated electrospray ionization, using a non-targeted metabolomics approach. A broad range of compounds (209) including polyphenols, amino acids, organic acids and their derivatives were identified based on accurate mass measurements with mass error (±5 ppm) and retention time matching (±0.2 min). Various metabolite profiles were observed across different regional samples, with certain marker compounds identified as potential indicators of geographical origin. Principal component analysis (PCA) further confirmed clear clustering and differentiation of tea samples based on the origin, highlighting the role of regional environmental factors such as climate, soil composition, and altitude. Molecular docking and dynamics were carried out to examine the interaction of theanine and the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn), a key regulator of IgG recycling and immune homeostasis, encoded by the FCGRT gene. Results showed that theanine forms a stable complex with the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) and maintained consistent hydrogen bonding, particularly with key residue Ile685, and preserved FcRn's secondary structure. Binding energy analysis (MM-PBSA) showed favourable interactions dominated by van der Waals forces, with theanine exhibiting a slightly higher binding affinity (-18.72 kcal mol-1) than RVT-1401 (-17.82 kcal mol-1), a therapeutic monoclonal antibody known to inhibit FcRn function. The findings have significant implications for the tea industry in quality control, authentication, traceability, and health benefits, which offer new insights into how territory shapes the chemical and potentially sensory attributes of black tea.
42093402.journal: Analytical methods : advancing methods and applications

42093402.title_zh: 通过 UHPLC-四极杆-Orbitrap Exploris HRMS 分析揭示红茶的地理特征。
42093402.abstract_zh:
了解红茶的地理差异对于探索地域对其化学成分的影响至关重要。在这项研究中，使用超高效液相色谱结合高分辨率质谱分析了来自印度西里古里、阿萨姆邦和伊杜基（喀拉拉邦）、孟加拉国锡尔赫特和斯里兰卡康提等主要茶叶产区的红茶（粉）样品。使用非靶向代谢组学方法，通过加热电喷雾电离的全 MS/ddMS2 模式对茶提取物进行分析。基于具有质量误差 (±5 ppm) 和保留时间匹配 (±0.2 分钟) 的精确质量测量，鉴定了多种化合物 (209)，包括多酚、氨基酸、有机酸及其衍生物。在不同区域样本中观察到了各种代谢物谱，某些标记化合物被确定为地理起源的潜在指标。主成分分析（PCA）进一步证实了茶叶样品基于产地的清晰聚类和分化，突出了气候、土壤成分和海拔等区域环境因素的作用。
通过分子对接和动力学研究茶氨酸与新生儿 Fc 受体 (FcRn) 的相互作用，FcRn 是由 FCGRT 基因编码的 IgG 回收和免疫稳态的关键调节因子。结果表明，茶氨酸与新生儿 Fc 受体 (FcRn) 形成稳定的复合物，并保持一致的氢键，特别是与关键残基 Ile685，并保留了 FcRn 的二级结构。结合能分析 (MM-PBSA) 显示以范德华力为主的有利相互作用，茶氨酸的结合亲和力 (-18.72 kcal mol-1) 略高于 RVT-1401 (-17.82 kcal mol-1)，RVT-1401 是一种已知抑制 FcRn 功能的治疗性单克隆抗体。这些发现对茶行业的质量控制、认证、可追溯性和健康益处具有重大影响，这为了解地域如何塑造红茶的化学和潜在感官属性提供了新的见解。

42037172.title: From Congestion to Clarity: On the Complementarity of Resolving Power and Spectral Simplification for Intact Protein Characterization.
42037172.abstract: Top-down mass spectrometry (TDMS) is a powerful platform for the structural and functional analysis of intact proteins, enabling the detailed characterization of proteoforms and precise localization of post-translational modifications. The incorporation of alternative fragmentation techniques, such as electron transfer dissociation, electron transfer higher-energy collisional dissociation, and ultraviolet photodissociation, in instruments such as Tribrid Orbitrap mass spectrometers enhances sequence coverage and improves the confidence in PTM assignment. However, tandem mass spectrometry of intact proteins >30 kDa presents substantial challenges. The resulting spectra are often highly complex with overlapping product ion signals that complicate spectral interpretation. Although increasing the mass resolution can help resolve closely spaced product ions, it is often insufficient to fully alleviate spectral congestion for large proteins. In such cases, proton transfer charge reduction (PTCR) can simplify mass spectra by dispersing product ions across a wider mass-over-charge (m/z) range. In this study, we evaluated the impact on TDMS of increasing resolving power and PTCR-enabled spectral simplification using four intact proteins: enolase (46.6 kDa), carbonic anhydrase (29 kDa), myoglobin (16.9 kDa), and ubiquitin (8.6 kDa). For carbonic anhydrase, combined MS2 fragmentation at low resolving power (60,000 at m/z 200) yielded 50.5% sequence coverage, which increased to 92.6% at high resolving power (480,000 at m/z 200) and further to 97.7% when PTCR was applied. This approach was applied to the characterization of biopharmaceuticals by analyzing the three digested and disulfide-reduced ∼25 kDa subunits of the NIST monoclonal antibody (mAb) on a liquid chromatography time scale.
42037172.journal: Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry
42037172.affiliation: Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, University of Oklahoma, Norman, Oklahoma 73019, United States.
42037172.title_zh: 从拥塞到清晰：关于完整蛋白质表征的分辨率和光谱简化的互补性。
42037172.abstract_zh:
自上而下的质谱 (TDMS) 是完整蛋白质结构和功能分析的强大平台，能够详细表征蛋白质形式并精确定位翻译后修饰。将电子转移解离、电子转移高能碰撞解离和紫外光解离等替代裂解技术结合到 Tribrid Orbitrap 质谱仪等仪器中，可增强序列覆盖率并提高 PTM 分配的置信度。然而，>30 kDa 的完整蛋白质的串联质谱分析面临着巨大的挑战。所得光谱通常非常复杂，产物离子信号重叠，使光谱解释变得复杂。尽管提高质量分辨率有助于解析紧密间隔的产物离子，但通常不足以完全缓解大蛋白质的光谱拥塞。在这种情况下，质子转移电荷还原 (PTCR) 可以通过将产物离子分散在更宽的质荷比 (m/z) 范围内来简化质谱。
在本研究中，我们使用四种完整蛋白质评估了提高分辨率和支持 PTCR 的光谱简化对 TDMS 的影响：烯醇化酶 (46.6 kDa)、碳酸酐酶 (29 kDa)、肌红蛋白 (16.9 kDa) 和泛素 (8.6 kDa)。对于碳酸酐酶，低分辨率（m/z 200 时 60,000）下的组合 MS2 断裂产生 50.5% 的序列覆盖率，高分辨率（m/z 200 时 480,000）时序列覆盖率增加至 92.6%，应用 PTCR 时进一步增加至 97.7%。该方法通过在液相色谱时间尺度上分析 NIST 单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的三个消化和二硫键还原的 ~25 kDa 亚基，应用于生物制药的表征。

41925250.title: Glycan pairing in therapeutic IgG orchestrates Fcγ receptor engagement and ADCC: an integrated structure-function approach for thorough evaluation of Fc N-glycans as critical quality attributes.
41925250.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) can mediate their therapeutic activity through antigen binding and by engaging Fc receptors (FcRs) or the complement system. FcRs are expressed on immune cells and can initiate effector functions such as antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) and antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis. The conserved Fc N-glycans of immunoglobulin G (IgG) at N297 modulate the strength and stability of Fc-FcγR interactions and the resulting effector responses. Conventional analysis typically considers individual glycans in isolation and neglects the fact that each Fc part carries two N-glycans, that may be paired symmetrically or asymmetrically. Recent studies with IgG Fc regions have demonstrated that glycan pairing can significantly shape Fc-FcR interactions. Here, the effect of glycan pairing was evaluated with full-length IgG using rituximab as a model. A set of pure, homogeneous, symmetrical, and asymmetrical Fc glyco-pair variants was generated by controlled chemoenzymatic remodeling and purification. Surface plasmon resonance binding studies across a comprehensive panel of human FcγRs revealed receptor- and allotype-specific effects: FcγRI binding was essentially unaffected, FcγRIIa showed allotype dependence, with FcγRIIa-H131 predominantly modulated by galactosylation and FcγRIIa-R131 by afucosylation, whereas FcγRIIIa required only a single afucosylation to reach maximal binding. Galactosylation exerted modest and receptor-dependent effects, most pronounced for FcγRIIIb. High-mannose species reduced binding to FcγRI and FcγRII, but displayed intermediate affinity to FcγRIIIa, which was lower than afucosylated complex types yet higher than fully fucosylated variants. To evaluate the biological relevance, cell-based ADCC reporter gene assays confirmed that single afucosylation was sufficient to drive the increase in ADCC potency, with galactosylation and high-mannose contributing only modest or context-dependent effects. Together, these findings establish glycan pairing as a critical quality attribute of therapeutic antibodies and provide a framework for precise evaluation of Fc N-glycan criticality and for tailoring mAbs with defined effector function profiles.
41925250.affiliation: Global Development CMC Biologicals, Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG, Biberach an der Riss, Germany.
41925250.title_zh: 治疗性 IgG 中的聚糖配对协调 Fcγ 受体结合和 ADCC：一种集成的结构功能方法，用于彻底评估 Fc N-聚糖作为关键质量属性。
41925250.abstract_zh:
单克隆抗体 (mAb) 可以通过抗原结合和结合 Fc 受体 (FcR) 或补体系统来介导其治疗活性。 FcR 在免疫细胞上表达，可以启动效应功能，例如抗体依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC) 和抗体依赖性细胞吞噬作用。 N297 处免疫球蛋白 G (IgG) 的保守 Fc N-聚糖调节 Fc-FcγR 相互作用的强度和稳定性以及由此产生的效应反应。传统分析通常考虑孤立的单个聚糖，而忽略了每个 Fc 部分携带两个 N-聚糖（可能对称或不对称配对）的事实。最近对 IgG Fc 区域的研究表明，聚糖配对可以显着影响 Fc-FcR 相互作用。在此，以利妥昔单抗为模型，通过全长 IgG 评估了聚糖配对的效果。通过受控的化学酶重构和纯化产生了一组纯的、均质的、对称的和不对称的Fc糖对变体。
对一系列人类 FcγR 进行的表面等离子共振结合研究揭示了受体和同种异型特异性效应：FcγRI 结合基本不受影响，FcγRIIa 显示同种异型依赖性，其中 FcγRIIa-H131 主要受半乳糖基化调节，FcγRIIa-R131 主要受无岩藻糖基化调节，而 FcγRIIIa 仅需要一次无岩藻糖基化即可达到最大结合。半乳糖基化发挥了适度的受体依赖性作用，对于 FcγRIIIb 最为明显。高甘露糖种类减少了与 FcγRI 和 FcγRII 的结合，但对 FcγRIIIa 表现出中等亲和力，低于无岩藻糖基化复合物类型，但高于完全岩藻糖基化变体。为了评估生物学相关性，基于细胞的 ADCC 报告基因测定证实，单一无岩藻糖基化足以驱动 ADCC 效力的增加，而半乳糖基化和高甘露糖仅贡献适度或依赖于环境的作用。总之，这些发现将聚糖配对确立为治疗性抗体的关键质量属性，并为精确评估 Fc N-聚糖关键性和定制具有明确效应子功能特征的 mAb 提供了框架。

41900807.title: Phosphatidylcholine-Polysorbate 20-Based Mixed Micelles: A New Option to Prevent Protein Aggregation?
41900807.abstract: Background/Objectives: Surfactants are commonly used to protect proteins from denaturation and particle formation, thereby ensuring the long-term stability of biopharmaceuticals. Polysorbates (PS) 20 and 80 are the most widely used surfactants in the pharmaceutical industry. However, alternative excipients such as poloxamers are currently under investigation. In this study, mixed micelles (MMs) composed of phospholipids (PL) and polysorbate 20 (PS20) were explored as a novel stabilisation strategy, aiming to reduce the PS content in protein formulations by partial substitution with PL. Despite their favourable properties, including thermodynamic stability and small particle size, MMs have seen limited application, and no reports exist on their use for stabilising antibody solutions. Results: In a first step, PS20/PL ratios were identified, which are advantageous to form stable MM solutions, followed by an optimization of the formulation process by introducing a second heating step using the direct dispersion method. Successful MM formation was confirmed via transmission and dynamic light scattering analyses at total surfactant concentrations of up to 20 mg·mL-1 and 50 mg·mL-1, with PL contents of 50% and up to 40%, respectively. These surfactant concentrations of up to 20 mg·mL-1 and 50 mg·mL-1 are substantially higher than the surfactant concentrations that are typically used in final biopharmaceutical formulations (0.01-2 mg·mL-1). Consequently, the mixed micellar system enables operation even at concentrations substantially above practical formulation limits. In the ensuing study, the stabilizing potential of the PL/PS20 micellar system was appraised through agitation studies. Methods: In these studies, bovine serum albumin was employed as a model protein, while a monoclonal antibody was used as a candidate therapeutic molecule. Stability was assessed through visual inspection, turbidity measurements, particle analysis, and size-exclusion chromatography. Conclusions: A protective effect comparable to that of PS20 alone was observed for both model proteins, demonstrating for the first time that MMs can effectively stabilise biologics.
41900807.affiliation: Institute of Pharmacy, Faculty of Biosciences, Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg, Wolfgang-Langenbeck-Strasse 4, 06120 Halle (Saale), Germany.
41900807.title_zh: 磷脂酰胆碱-聚山梨酯 20 混合胶束：防止蛋白质聚集的新选择？

背景/目标：表面活性剂通常用于保护蛋白质免于变性和颗粒形成，从而确保生物制药的长期稳定性。聚山梨酯 (PS) 20 和 80 是制药行业中使用最广泛的表面活性剂。然而，替代赋形剂如泊洛沙姆目前正在研究中。在本研究中，探索了由磷脂（PL）和聚山梨酯20（PS20）组成的混合胶束（MM）作为一种新型稳定策略，旨在通过用PL部分替代来降低蛋白质配方中的PS含量。尽管MM具有良好的特性，包括热力学稳定性和小粒径，但其应用有限，并且没有关于它们用于稳定抗体溶液的报道。结果：第一步确定了 PS20/PL 比率，这有利于形成稳定的 MM 溶液，然后通过使用直接分散法引入第二个加热步骤来优化配制过程。
通过透射和动态光散射分析证实了MM的成功形成，表面活性剂总浓度高达20 mg·mL-1和50 mg·mL-1，PL含量分别为50%和40%。这些表面活性剂浓度高达 20 mg·mL-1 和 50 mg·mL-1，远高于最终生物制药制剂中通常使用的表面活性剂浓度 (0.01-2 mg·mL-1)。因此，混合胶束系统甚至可以在远高于实际配方极限的浓度下运行。在随后的研究中，通过搅拌研究评估了 PL/PS20 胶束系统的稳定潜力。方法：在这些研究中，牛血清白蛋白被用作模型蛋白，而单克隆抗体被用作候选治疗分子。通过目视检查、浊度测量、颗粒分析和尺寸排阻色谱法评估稳定性。结论：两种模型蛋白均观察到与单独 PS20 相当的保护作用，首次证明 MM 可以有效稳定生物制剂。
